name: Adam Schiff
subject: We can’t go back
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6629%2E5257348%2EsRZFGz)
Derek — We are facing the most coordinated, sustained backlash against LGBTQ equality in our lifetimes.
This year alone, more than 500 anti-LGBTQ bills have been filed in state legislatures across the nation.
These continued restrictions and acts of hate against the LGBTQ community — especially toward students, parents, and teachers — are cruel.
Everyone deserves to feel safe and _be safe_ regardless of who they love or how they identify. The coordinated legislative maneuvers and outright violent attacks to threaten and intimidate transgender children and their parents in particular are unconscionable.
We will not go back — we will not apologize for celebrating the strength and diversity of our LGBTQ community.
It may seem unbelievable, but currently, the _1964 Civil Rights Act_ does NOT explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation or gender identity.
That’s unacceptable, and it’s why we must fight like hell to defend the LGBTQ community from violence, intimidation, and outright discrimination no matter what.
I'm an original cosponsor of the _Equality Act_ to amend the _1964 Civil Rights Act_ and establish clear protections against this form of discrimination. And in the Senate, I'll vote to abolish the filibuster so we can pass it with a simple majority once and for all.
**[Derek, add your name to my petition and urge Congress to pass the _Equality Act_. We won’t go back, and we will fight like hell to defend the LGBTQ community from violence, intimidation, and outright discrimination no matter what.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240604-equality-act.-nzZnh&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240604_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6629%2E5257348%2EsRZFGz)**

This is a matter of principle. This Pride Month, it is each of our responsibility to stand with our LGTBQ community and keep moving forward until we have achieved the true equality that is the birthright of every person in our country.
Thanks.

clean_body: | Derek — We are facing the most coordinated, sustained backlash against LGBTQ equality in our lifetimes. This year alone, more than 500 anti-LGBTQ bills have been filed in state legislatures across the nation. These continued restrictions and acts of hate against the LGBTQ community — especially toward students, parents, and teachers — are cruel. Everyone deserves to feel safe and be safe regardless of who they love or how they identify. The coordinated legislative maneuvers and outright violent attacks to threaten and intimidate transgender children and their parents in particular are unconscionable. We will not go back — we will not apologize for celebrating the strength and diversity of our LGBTQ community. Summer heat is here, Peter. Temperatures in Phoenix have already been breaking 100° F consistently, and they show no signs of cooling down. It's just another reminder that our city is on the front lines of the climate crisis, and we know that extreme heat can be deadly. The rising temperatures have made national news with the _Washington Post_ recently publishing the headline about another record heat wave: [**_Heat wave in the West prompts warnings for Las Vegas, Phoenix and Sacramento_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86286326/477410670/-746520390?ms=240604_ya_summer&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2EwMWNlOS1kMDIyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XN4BaG6ZhQzDstgHShsrzkGIpiTr-ACAkWPAZu_DHec=&emci=cff2d316-6c22-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=53a01ce9-d022-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=45157234) _The punishing “heat dome” from Mexico is expanding northward, threatening records from Texas to the Pacific Northwest, including in California._ **That's why I've dedicated my life to fighting the climate crisis, and why I've worked as hard as anyone to keep Arizonans safe from life-threatening temperatures.** As a senior policy advisor to the United Nations, I helped construct the Paris Climate Accords, and I made sustainability and climate resilience central to my work on the Phoenix City Council, including delivering our city's first Climate Action Plan and first Transportation Electrification Action Plan. In just two years, we laid over 100 miles of cool pavement, established the country’s first publicly funded Office of Heat Response & Mitigation, planted hundreds of trees in under-shaded neighborhoods, and passed one of the most ambitious renewable energy transition plans in the country. But local actions alone can't solve this problem. We need urgent, large-scale climate policy, and we need it immediately. Last summer, our city experienced _**31 consecutive days of temperatures over 110° F**_. Heatwaves like that are disastrous for ecosystems and communities alike. And only bold, federal climate action can stop this crisis from getting worse. **[That's why I'm taking this fight to Washington. clean_body: Our city is on the front lines of the climate emergency. We need a climate champion like Yassamin in Congress. | | = Summer heat is here, Peter. Temperatures in Phoenix have already been breaking 100° F consistently, and they show no signs of cooling down. It's just another reminder that our city is on the front lines of the climate crisis, and we know that extreme heat can be deadly. The rising temperatures have made national news with the Washington Post recently publishing the headline about another record heat wave: The punishing “heat dome” from Mexico is expanding northward, threatening records from Texas to the Pacific Northwest, including in California. That's why I've dedicated my life to fighting the climate crisis, and why I've worked as hard as anyone to keep Arizonans safe from life-threatening temperatures. As a senior policy advisor to the United Nations, I helped construct the Paris Climate Accords, and I made sustainability and climate resilience central to my work on the Phoenix City Council, including delivering our city's first Climate Action Plan and first Transportation Electrification Action Plan. In just two years, we laid over 100 miles of cool pavement, established the country’s first publicly funded Office of Heat Response & Mitigation, planted hundreds of trees in under-shaded neighborhoods, and passed one of the most ambitious renewable energy transition plans in the country. But local actions alone can't solve this problem. We need urgent, large-scale climate policy, and we need it immediately. Last summer, our city experienced 31 consecutive days of temperatures over 110° F. Heatwaves like that are disastrous for ecosystems and communities alike. And only bold, federal climate action can stop this crisis from getting worse. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: = = = = = Thank you, Peter. — Yassamin | Yassamin Ansari is the former Vice Mayor of Phoenix and the youngest woman ever elected to the Phoenix City Council. body:
Make no mistake, this sham prosecution is about more than just President Trump.
My father and our entire family is more committed than ever to fight for the country we love and the people who have always stood by our side.

|
---
| | |
Friend,

It's a dark day in America.

When my father decided to run for President, I knew it wouldn't be easy.

But I never imagined that they would attempt to strip him of his liberty and turn him into a political prisoner.

It’s a moment that reminds me of Bobby Kennedy’s eulogy of his brother, President John F. Kennedy, at the Democratic convention. Bobby Kennedy said that JFK would have never been able to accomplish any of what he did without the support of all of you -- the Democratic Party. He said that when we’re in it together, we can accomplish a great deal. That's true in helping President Biden defeat Donald Trump; it's true in electing Democrats up and down the ballot; and it's true when it comes to continuing the progress of the last several years. Peter,

**I’m thrilled to announce that I have officially secured the Republican nomination to represent New Mexico’s Second Congressional District!** _Now, the real battle begins._

I’m running against radical left Democrat Gabe Vasquez, a candidate with a criminal record, deep-seated disdain for law enforcement and the rule of law, and a disgraceful voting record that aligns him with Joe Biden and the far-left agenda plaguing our country.

[ ** _JOIN TEAM YVETTE!_ **](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=cf8a08fc93554b3f82b17e9c915fced9&_e=1vMOXiEVE4cLSB1wfWb9ZTZOCq3kj1021JqF3p9CH4vcd29JWneAW5OL9fcoARbDsBLUwzeyimTTtj9xDpVg2z8AA-cPZzjU0J2nmq0twzGdHZ97HKziSTdsgP6ThAuH97BcAjuouWYRwlMdsyq4H65_zxo0TsIDVQaNxWm1cmBR0V9DOtFKmXqtxlRfr_975RTrPEnfyArCXcCJPdO6LmPlgMZ4Kai-YfqE5KWXGz27XxxSXl6H5LWbj-rnlP7A-4dG67X-QQNX5YB_WtEY0gm04qm8CHTggTUUEoFM-TmaW8Te4sUJeH5cSvekvs9AhNSDm9V5jP89SGp7KHQaF0a8Rs1fltEhbLBMMc20hdqbqGGlgsqKBj3frngRmTjeQeNaMiq7doJhbIDUgzYQXuhU5POkKfq7zUv7uE_2Dq8%3D)
**I am committed to the values that make our state and our country great, and that’s exactly why President Donald J. Trump has endorsed my campaign.**

I am dedicated to fighting for New Mexico’s families, protecting our freedoms, and standing up against the radical policies that threaten our way of life. I will always put the interests of New Mexico and America FIRST!

But I can’t do this alone. With this being one of the most-watched and contested races in the country, [**I need your support to ensure we have the resources to win this critical election and bring common-sense leadership back to Washington!**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=cf8a08fc93554b3f82b17e9c915fced9&_e=1vMOXiEVE4cLSB1wfWb9ZTZOCq3kj1021JqF3p9CH4vcd29JWneAW5OL9fcoARbDsBLUwzeyimTTtj9xDpVg2z8AA-cPZzjU0J2nmq0twzGdHZ97HKziSTdsgP6ThAuH97BcAjuouWYRwlMdsyq4H65_zxo0TsIDVQaNxWm1cmBR0V9DOtFKmXqtxlRfr_975RTrPEnfyArCXcCJPdO6LmPlgMZ4Kai-YfqE5KWXGz27XxxSXl6H5LWbj-rnlP7A-4dG67X-QQNX5YB_WtEY0izf0NHgPbi1i1leJs2dNq0VLKRCsMH4mIVYEz28FuWrpPnkGca00Y-hh-01WmdX4qrNYk6p7pyPgVODBoWxY_IcyCL4xZp2yu56bauwE5yEYOsbBZ505jlGv9iGFqfmQAW1o-30WpwcS4HnPpPG5hw%3D)

**Why Your Support Matters:**

1. **Protecting Our Values: ** Gabe Vasquez has a record of supporting radical policies that are out of touch with New Mexico’s values. I will fight to protect our conservative principles and ensure your voices are heard.
2. **Law and Order: ** Unlike Gabe Vasquez, whose criminal record raises serious concerns, I stand for law and order, supporting our brave law enforcement officers, and will do everything I can to secure our southern border.
3. **Fighting Biden’s Agenda: ** I will stand up to Joe Biden and the radical Democrats, opposing reckless spending, overreaching regulations, and policies that have hurt our economy and jobs.

You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5r74ttd2b8ge9p7v9ne2g22me7lusgjvkinbklo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs)

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2bp6f0745pfc6cr679v0quihrterhe0qt2iv38o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z57j4a14rsshbt26gefmiib70u5u3q3gc54ij810_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs) [No](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z05n9r86shoqca509spk42d4g541mulha9g3b5lo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zuuroa1ncrrhbsq160e0pt95ljc4s8p2daju2uh8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zovt6usi23ef1jf6eg87m2lr44mdud4mau6ek8s8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clge0pr4cjh2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: Jim Carris
subject: Carris for Congress Weekly Update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carris for Congress
body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-e-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-a/) Our campaign is proud to announce former Senator Mark Kirk and former Congressman Bob Dold's endorsement! I am deeply honored to have the endorsement of both Senator Kirk and Congressman Dold. Both men have worked tirelessly throughout their tenures in office to represent the needs of our District. Their commitment to our service men and women, law enforcement, and community speak to their integrity and deep understanding of the District and its legacy. I am grateful for the opportunity to partner with these strong leaders and look forward to a victory in November's general election. [Read Our Press Release Here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-r/) Team Carris,

The three pillars of my campaign are public safety, national security, and our economy. As a former business owner and senior executive, as a taxpayer, and as a father with two kids still in public schools hoping to instill sound financial wisdom in my children, I could not sit on the sidelines anymore. The national economy has been experiencing significant uncertainty, and the 10th Congressional District is no exception. The U.S. inflation rate for 2023 was 3.4%, higher than the Federal Reserve's target rate of 2%. The economic landscape is completely uncertain under President Biden's current administration and Washington and Illinois' economic policies have created headwinds that are hurting businesses and households alike. **As a result, the cost of everyday items has increased by almost 20% since January 2021, putting a strain on household budgets**. Our District has seen a noticeable increase in the cost of living, increased energy and food costs, and the price of housing. This situation is compounded by increasing property taxes, utility costs, and healthcare expenses.
According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, **the cost of living in our District has increased by more than 19.9 % or $1,000 more per month for a family of four to afford the essentials - rent, food, and transportation - than it did just three and a half years ago. **The numbers are stark:
* **Housing:** The median home price in our District has **risen by around 8%** with rental prices also seeing a sharp increase
* **Food and Essentials:** The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) provides a Food Price Index Forecast and food prices are predicted to **increase by another 1.3%** in 2024
* **Utilities:** An average electricity bill in Illinois is $115.92 and nationally, electricity bills **increased 6.25%** from in 2023, based on annual data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
* **Healthcare:** As of 2021, Illinois leads the latest list of states with the largest proportion (63.6%) of premiums that have **increased by 10% or more**

We currently have a representative in office who has been there for **ten years -** **an entire decade**. Over those ten years, all of Illinois families' expenses have increased across the board. **Brad Schneider is anything but moderate on federal spending.** He has supported all of Biden's massive spending bills, which are a main cause for driving up inflation, including the American Rescue Plan and the so-called Inflation Reduction Act.He has consistently been hostile to efforts to cut taxes on individuals and businesses. During his 2012 primary campaign, he called for allowing all of the Bush tax cuts to expire at the end of the year. Schneider was an outspoken opponent of the 2017 tax reform law, complaining that it was overly generous to the wealthy. The Biden administration has declared that they would not support an extension of the The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act ("TCJA") which has benefitted American taxpayers and encouraged capital investment in economically distressed communities, and since Brad Schneider has voted 97% of the time with Nancy Pelosi and the Biden administration, we can expect him to fall in line and vote against the extension.Schneider has also repeatedly defended the Inflation Reduction Act's provision requiring the hiring of thousands of new IRS agents to more aggressively audit taxpayers. He has also called for raising Social Security taxes for many American workers. In 2012, and again in 2016, Schneider said that he supported raising Social Security's taxable earnings cap, which (as of 2024) would result in additional taxes for workers making more than $168,600. A 2016 study by the Congressional Budget Office and the Joint Committee on Taxation estimated that raising or eliminating the taxable earnings cap would result in as much as $1 trillion in higher taxes over a 10-year period.Enough is enough. It's time to send someone with real business experience to Congress. In Washington, I will be committed to addressing these challenges. I will put forth and advocate for policies that support small businesses, which are the backbone of our local economy. I will support the extension of the tax cuts set to expire in 2025 and I will push for affordable housing programs to ensure that everyone has access to safe and reasonably priced homes. I will also support legislation aimed at controlling prescription drug prices and healthcare costs. Energy independence is also the cornerstone of a sound economy and I will promote the use of cleaner burning fuels such as natural gas as well as sustainable energy solutions to help reduce utility expenses over time and also work to create jobs across our District and the country. **It 's time to put money back into the wallets of hardworking families in the 10th District. ** Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **National Gun Violence Awareness Month** *Source: Lake County Gun Violence Prevention Initiative 2024 Violence Prevention PlanJune is National Gun Violence Awareness Month. According to the Winnetka-based [March Fourth](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-y/) organization, between January and October 2023, there were 587 mass shootings in 44 states, resulting in 650 people killed and an additional 2,485 injured. The number of mass shootings each year has risen about 20% year over year since 2019. [Lake County](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-j/) alone saw 14 gun-related homicides in 2020 and a record high of 21 in 2021. Over 80% of these firearm related homicides occurred in the three most historically underserved cities in Lake County - North Chicago, Waukegan, and Zion. According to March Fourth, "Wounds caused by assault weapons are more severe and lethal than wounds caused by other firearms, and, particularly when paired with large capacity magazines, assault weapons can injure more people more quickly. Because of this lethality, assault weapons are frequently the guns of choice for individuals who carry out horrific public attacks. An analysis of public mass shootings resulting in four or more deaths found that more than 85% of such fatalities were caused by assault rifles."Most citizens aren't aware that the United States has actual data on the effect of limiting access to assault weapons. **In fact, from 1994 through 2004, the Public Safety and Recreational Firearms Use Protection Act, commonly called the Federal Assault Weapons Ban, prohibited "the manufacture, transfer, or possession of a semiautomatic assault weapon," and it specified which semiautomatic assault weapons were included. **When Congress did not renew it in 2004, the Act expired.One of the [most-cited studies](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-t/) on the effectiveness of the ban was done in 2004 by the National Institute of Justice at the Department of Justice and found that the number of gun crimes involving automatic weapons dropped by 17% in the six cities involved in the study during the ban.Since the Federal Assaults Weapons Ban expired in 2004, the average [number of yearly deaths attributed to mass shootings](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-i/) was 25, compared with 5.3 during the 10-year tenure of the ban and 7.2 in the years leading up to the prohibition on assault weapons.I am committed to continuing to research and educate myself on the latest numbers related to gun violence, in our District and beyond. I am supportive of the [Gas-Operated Semi-Automatic Firearms Exclusion Act](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-d/) (GOSAFE Act), a pragmatic proposal designed to protect communities from gun violence while safeguarding Americans' constitutional right to own a firearm for legitimate self-defense, hunting, or sporting purposes. **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Honoring Our Fallen Servicemen and Women on Memorial Day**
Our family traveled around the District to pay our respects to the honorable men and women who paid the ultimate sacrifice to ensure our freedom. My kids and I were proud to join the American Legion McKinlock Post 264 and other community members in Lake Forest to post flags around town and at the Lake Forest and St. Mary's cemeteries. We also visited the Fort Sheridan National Cemetery and joined the Grayslake community at the annual Memorial Day parade and ceremony! We met many selfless veterans and their families and were proud to join the attendees in celebrating the commemoration of part of U.S Route 45 from Belvedere Rd. to Washington St. in honor of Marine Lance Cpl. Sean P. Maher who died on February 2, 2005 in Iraq during Operation Iraqi Freedom. May Sean and all of our nation's veterans rest in peace knowing that their legacies live on in their loved ones and their communities. 🇺🇸 **Joining Congressman LaHood and Former Speaker Johnson in Tazewell County**
I was thrilled to attend the annual Tazewell County/Peoria County Lincoln Day Dinner with special guest Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson. The evening was full of energy and excitement and it was deeply motivating to see so many Republicans committed to working together for the betterment of our state and our country. _Photo: Courtesy of Dean White_ Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-h/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-k/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-n/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:**
My father joined us at a fundraising event this past week which meant the world to me. His story of immigration, hard work, and love for family is what instilled a passion for public service in me. Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-p/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-x/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-m/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehyjuz-tlidtddjku-c/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqukoa1eivhf5npbnrqrnf91ovkgvnh9eo1ne4tg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clgecob1c1h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp1rk7166346a1qbvje50kj1pdnbreb6hj2cec1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clgecob1c1h2bs) [No](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm5d15v8o556oa77qupoo6ui5r5e7t6ggph0kqf0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clgecob1c1h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za1et342dag82cn0gvrkpbpc1i06mmh2oelvtlfo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clgecob1c1h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8sekn35i97fn40kfkrremoiipmbgsqngld8jab0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37clgecob1c1h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

## Biden Pivots on Border Security
President Biden issued an executive order Tuesday on border security as the White House looks to [limit the number of asylum seekers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp_G3oiuMb8DQ5ds6drRAnNJbgUmwtRp3r5Kly7dvk9nOTofl-XiKdN2ffcFXU918WunAxfFJONiEWN0CZHjPKKb9KSlBS3FeHOzVcFrBVJZrpX0OhofPCpr-BxQ4UiOAxegQIKRaoKTEBYBYDIqRWs4DAIwUq_t9Flp6zdM-VkPbKe1ljG7W-_3fZjfBn4e-NnfN3zsL_Q6rdOaceDnQBE35vdn_iqs0LX5TnVjVP52wW9aKwu1RWws4iqTmYNQJkhtpdA2pClJFFZbG-XYXLw_KGfalR4EXIun_GvU_81zOP4TAAD__6isZpI) and neutralize immigration as an election issue. The new policy calls for border officials to limit the number of asylum seekers when encounters at points of entry exceed 2,500 per day. The current daily average of illegal crossings exceeds that number and was last below 2,500 in January 2021. The ACLU said Biden's [order was restrictive, dangerous,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPozAQhX-N6RwNE2OgcHENXa69Ehl7DHOycWRMsvn3q2zarV7xpE_vff9u881y5H39axOZGvJsXeUHzVp2EtWsGm8CEdK1IdP2bd-N0Heq2YxTymnnaelG0DaAC6NeSC02IKFbQsMGARVo6GDodAsXpUYCgHbQwY8DglBAnmsul_-Z97pRiK_8oHJxOTXRbLXeD3H9I3ASONWNNo7x3Qmctpxop-chcLI-8c5HLbZy3gVOqgccOiWti6d0m42R9pXkwp52SV_kzvdBmYunIpdPcEq8fgiyljPdpT1e8UxysW9kU4y_PzlGPnQvFKzJ8s-Upv7q7GHwOwAA__99OHGs) and violated people's legal right to seek asylum. The group said it plans to sue the Biden administration. House [Speaker Mike Johnson said](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ywyAQhJ8GOjzHiR-poEijzmlTaiRxMjhIeADbydtn7Drd7myx831f5-k8xxSPy-e8k2tbnua1xQdNRmiBalLcu40IqePkpJVWD2C14sHZ1Q7bapZu0YMlr3rSqDpp_DqTlMbw6BBQgQENvTYSTkoNBACyN5sfegSmgHxsuZyuOR4t0JZ-84PKac07Ty60dqus-2A4MhxboBBTem0Mx5B3OuhZ3_FeieGoLKCWIOqN5m8q4prDUfMhlujpEEsunoqgH1rvLz7x7gxHXpy_PWNKsRrLFFz2Ob5fePtXx8PhXwAAAP__Up1h6w) it was Biden's policies that created the border problem and that the new executive action was "weak."
## Disney, Florida Make Up with $17 Billion Deal
Florida and Disney are moving toward approving [a $17 billion development plan for Walt Disney World](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGnMZ3RePwDFC5uQ7e3TYksz7A4Mni1dkC8fZTUqU9xpO_jsTxCyul4_g87-7aWJcSWTl6ctBLNYjryKzOy7tirQQ12gsGabvNTRFKO1KqNI9LRjiM5FaIOATAG3SWPgAYcWBitU9AbMzEAqNGtNI0IwgBTauXdf5Z0tI3XfJeT330se5f91tqrCv1P4Cxwvq6rv8NWyk8VOB98VYEzpXrwXSXxybm8dj6aJA5ZEtdwtFRlLF-ZpNJgrdJW91vbc_f29LpSzqm6QRh47iHl32370-D0-B0AAP__lL5eXg), a major turnaround from the long battle that began when Disney spoke out against the state's education policies. The Central Florida Tourism Oversight District is set to hold a public hearing on the development plan before voting whether to approve it on June 15. _"What you've seen is a huge kiss and make-up between Florida and Disney,"_ [said theme park industry insider Dennis Speigel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb896YLDjgaEZrC7p2tFC4RGTYLCA2M3fV-nc8epKR0fn-zJfjA8-3r7MSrq6NJtr9TvNPSgQcpaN1Y5IUNeQ5gMf1IiDks2ix6FTdFWcejd2gpTlfBzEgD1KdG50jdcChcQeFZ5Uz7GVciRE5Kfe2fEkkEkk62vK7T35WBdy4ZV2yu01rU3QS61bYd0HExMT03Ec7Vri-2NiogjPwsRUs9kpMDFFOt7bwPK8ETx8KWCihdU8CJ4bWF8iveBIOVhwIWVvDQQylnKBLaQKq7mnDPSzmVh8im9WhvOZx_gpzk3Wdjt8CL70A5N4W40Pf5r132a7Fr8BAAD__0CFbtg), CEO of International Theme Park Services. While Disney has not confirmed specific plans, the investment could lead to the development of a [much-rumored fifth theme park](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwY6bdUXwCoo0dpc2pYOwniTIMspo7u0zSZ36L_6Z7-MxPVxMMT_f3Ua2Ljw5X-NJk5a9RDWpJtiFCKlryLamNf0dTK-a1ZIzutfGq3YwbvAzDEE5TzD70HWO5iZaBFSgoYeh1y3clLoTALSDXsJ9QBAKKMTK--2TY64rLenFJ-03z1uT7FprOUT3JnAUOM6JOTGX3yhwrCttJIvbvwSOma5D4BjopMRlo1xlIJdkiEeml7x4T0HSd3H5iJwFjs1uQ7liSvHQRih4bi6mv2391-C0-BMAAP__Irtf4A) at Walt Disney World, joining Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Disney's Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom.
## AI Workers Warn of Danger to Humanity
A group of employees from leading AI companies, including OpenAI and Google DeepMind, [published an open letter Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdEbrxRhcuEhDd2lTIp-9HJsz-ATWofx95NRpZkYa6Y00X7f55jnx_vj0G7my5NmHwm-ajewl6lk30S1ESF1DTg1q6C0MvW5Wh2bs7obGCBTtsCjVReystyGiRatCww4BNRjoYeyNglZrSwCgRrNEOyIIDRS55KP9zryXlZb0k990tCFvTXJrKa9TdB8CJ4HTdV1t2O-hlgKnihY4galSU37R7llWk57lwefzlMmHp8yLrNSTH2tp17Kl5nDxdXFKfJpBaHhsntPfaPn3gbfD3wAAAP__f61blw) expressing concern that the industry is growing too fast without sufficient oversight. The employees claim that [strict confidentiality agreements](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdEbrxRgoXKShu7QpkQNr2Mh3RrDCur-PSJ1qNNJo9PS-HtMjcOLX-hme5CXmKczCF01OtxrtZKvFRyKkpiJvOtO1A3StrTZPYGNE5wwghbBYDPOMBmkeYLbUYMUeAS04aKFvnYHa2oEAwPQuLkOPoCzQwpKP-ifzSzaK6Z0vOuo5P6vkN5H9VM2HwlHhWEqpZaOLjpXugcLxvlc4OoXjnWhNZ7BvFI55p1dgfYZI8tZ304lE6NBl41MSfadc6NBh5erwy144JT5dpyysz8Dpj0D-1XF5_A0AAP__hq5gIw) prevent them from sharing information about the risks of artificial intelligence, including the potential of runaway AI "resulting in human extinction." They argue that while these risks can be mitigated, AI companies have strong financial incentives to avoid effective oversight, with the generative AI market predicted to be worth $1 trillion within a decade. ([Read the Letter](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FugzAQANCvsbeg43K2YfDQhS1dOyIXn-EqgyPHAvXvK3XOB7zhfT3mR5Asx_oZdvYtlTksTU6e7c3ckGbS0Sdm5Ltm37vemRGcIb15CwuBc9aFiMl-R0cJIrpIEGBEIi0eAQksGBiM7aEjGhkA-sGmOA4IioCjtFK7nyJH2zjl33Jy7Zay6-y31p4vdf9QOCmcqqxba-UK9eiCKJx09fF5Sc7ysk4RrHuQ_E_b28fp8S8AAP__F81Ipw))

Did you get a chance to read my previous email?

My name is David Olson, you may have seen my recent interview with Shift WA about my candidacy for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction. With over a decade of experience serving as a member of the Peninsula School District Board of Directors, I am on a mission to find solutions to the biggest problems facing our K-12 public schools.

For parents with kids in schools (and anyone else concerned with the condition of K-12 public schools), I hope you will take a moment to read the email forwarded below.

Best,

David

I know that the condition of K-12 education is a critical issue for working families across our state - fortunately, this election cycle, we have a real opportunity to repair much of the damage done in recent years. | | [](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252590:s2x5qkWND:m:1:2714570852:2EF826465C914D319F85EE13A35243E8:r "David
Olson for Superintendent of Public Instruction")
---
|
Friends,

My name is David Olson. You may have seen my recent "Newsmaker Interview" with Shift WA. But, if you haven't, I hope you will allow me to take a quick moment and share why I am running for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction.

As a dedicated member of the Peninsula School District Board of Directors for over a decade, I've worked hard to bring positive change to public schools in my district. Now I'm on a mission to improve K-12 education across our state. Here's a glimpse of my vision and priorities:

**Why I'm Running:** I am motivated by deep concerns about the current administration under Chris Reykdal and the need for a more collaborative relationship between the Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI) and local school boards. OSPI should support our locally elected school boards - not dictate to them - because they know what's best for their community.

**Top Priorities:** My goals include pushing for fair funding, getting parents back involved with curriculum, fully supporting special education, and addressing chronic absenteeism by engaging parents and communities more effectively. But more than anything else, I want to refocus our schools on teaching kids how to read and write and pass their math classes.

**Overcoming Challenges:** We need strong leadership at OSPI. I advocate for a return to rigorous, science-based curricula and giving more control back to local school boards.

**Successful Policies:** In my district, we successfully banned social media and cell phones in schools, leading to less stress and better engagement among students. I aim to replicate such successes statewide.

I know that the condition of K-12 education is a critical issue for working families across our state - fortunately, this election cycle, we have a real opportunity to repair much of the damage done in recent years.

This campaign is about making a real difference for our state's children and their future. To achieve this, I am reaching out to ask for your financial support. _**[Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a significant impact on our efforts to bring much-needed change to Washington's educational system.](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252591:s2x5qkWND:m:1:2714570852:2EF826465C914D319F85EE13A35243E8:r)**_

_**[Please consider donating today to support our campaign and help us transform education in our state.](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252591:s2x5qkWND:m:1:2714570852:2EF826465C914D319F85EE13A35243E8:r)**_

Thank you for your support,

David Olson
Candidate for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ObEb577I9J4E-POa48I-sQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQs08P0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3N1cnZleS1pbmZvcm1lZC1jaXRpemVuLz9zYz0wMDU4Mk4wMjQyTDBBRE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249c3RhdGVfb2ZfZWR1Y2F0aW9uJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVlFU05PX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDYwNVcDc3BjQgpmWNg0YGZ4nX-SUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ObEb577I9J4E-POa48I-sQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQs08P0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3N1cnZleS1pbmZvcm1lZC1jaXRpemVuLz9zYz0wMDU4Mk4wMjQyTDBBRE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249c3RhdGVfb2ZfZWR1Y2F0aW9uJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVlFU05PX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDYwNVcDc3BjQgpmWNg0YGZ4nX-SUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) [No](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ObEb577I9J4E-POa48I-sQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQs08P0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3N1cnZleS1pbmZvcm1lZC1jaXRpemVuLz9zYz0wMDU4Mk4wMjQyTDBBRE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249c3RhdGVfb2ZfZWR1Y2F0aW9uJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVlFU05PX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDYwNVcDc3BjQgpmWNg0YGZ4nX-SUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ObEb577I9J4E-POa48I-sQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQs08P0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3N1cnZleS1pbmZvcm1lZC1jaXRpemVuLz9zYz0wMDU4Mk4wMjQyTDBBRE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249c3RhdGVfb2ZfZWR1Y2F0aW9uJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVlFU05PX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDYwNVcDc3BjQgpmWNg0YGZ4nX-SUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lodSHAJXL1LgG59N97ipoA~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lodSHAJXL1LgG59N97ipoA~~/AARclAA~)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lodSHAJXL1LgG59N97ipoA~~/AARclAA~) [No](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lodSHAJXL1LgG59N97ipoA~~/AARclAA~) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lodSHAJXL1LgG59N97ipoA~~/AARclAA~)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276423abfbf84f89a72649d6f9dedab5&_e=q0kc4vlz3RjH7XIjWScn1Nbt35uIpbIoQCfEqA8PW6MAn-3zcm8erFiw7I0OKdHTlirzjJ8HgOrfv-PXYqvBalUqs_FzJRYPlzRlGsA65q_-YXkZj-lJsi0Q7Jg7C-W6O7e0ER1JhBjHdhGkAUaEEdwdCFGos3S6YsI2LHXV480320GcySgygBz42Gmy5zCzOwcMA4SFH_iZIVQsjso4TigmRn9d6sm5mqX36AAy-1TScSU23xtrKiLY8nrnk9RA_Aa5ejIxLRJtKHIFYvGB8Utcy3fQMZzHZVcCMcfGxn4z_RCLDpaKUpN6mp3tP0tFwFdwjbpDAk3Qxa7EQBDTZKkUn6jw_FBENUVZgceVPzFUhvlj7O7JKJ5D0Am9lwjDS4jCAtNQnbBvpF3G3BKifA%3D%3D)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276423abfbf84f89a72649d6f9dedab5&_e=q0kc4vlz3RjH7XIjWScn1Nbt35uIpbIoQCfEqA8PW6MAn-3zcm8erFiw7I0OKdHTlirzjJ8HgOrfv-PXYqvBalUqs_FzJRYPlzRlGsA65q_-YXkZj-lJsi0Q7Jg7C-W6O7e0ER1JhBjHdhGkAUaEEdwdCFGos3S6YsI2LHXV480320GcySgygBz42Gmy5zCzOwcMA4SFH_iZIVQsjso4TigmRn9d6sm5mqX36AAy-1TScSU23xtrKiLY8nrnk9RAy4hqlD2qVdlX6eAirijqxIqYQFcilzYqQ4U5pKTD_psDIEeBCVO6Saw26qA6XoKl0xNlr_PXCB5rUXt-n_mtIrVD4odoV0vvgkJaBLKhQ2A5GGcm1qCK4W9dtGbe-lZWAQDTl0RlsgfcH-P3gtvwTQ%3D%3D) [No](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276423abfbf84f89a72649d6f9dedab5&_e=q0kc4vlz3RjH7XIjWScn1Nbt35uIpbIoQCfEqA8PW6MAn-3zcm8erFiw7I0OKdHTlirzjJ8HgOrfv-PXYqvBalUqs_FzJRYPlzRlGsA65q_-YXkZj-lJsi0Q7Jg7C-W6O7e0ER1JhBjHdhGkAUaEEdwdCFGos3S6YsI2LHXV480320GcySgygBz42Gmy5zCzOwcMA4SFH_iZIVQsjso4TigmRn9d6sm5mqX36AAy-1TScSU23xtrKiLY8nrnk9RAHcjfh7KUIgLO-eySI1dH2xsv1_fkj2RnTbHNTvmN4g3dwGLnlAdSgJaW5rwQGlHrJ6DTC2pJPV4HWplyh7oThYTls8ivvtcriR8_wGqE-qb5NEpc6f8tgPQ3j6rzS4NpD9wB7wptTcJrQXQ77MIC_Q%3D%3D) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=276423abfbf84f89a72649d6f9dedab5&_e=q0kc4vlz3RjH7XIjWScn1Nbt35uIpbIoQCfEqA8PW6MAn-3zcm8erFiw7I0OKdHTlirzjJ8HgOrfv-PXYqvBalUqs_FzJRYPlzRlGsA65q_-YXkZj-lJsi0Q7Jg7C-W6O7e0ER1JhBjHdhGkAUaEEdwdCFGos3S6YsI2LHXV480320GcySgygBz42Gmy5zCzOwcMA4SFH_iZIVQsjso4TigmRn9d6sm5mqX36AAy-1TScSU23xtrKiLY8nrnk9RAuYq3Ool3def6aCNxSl4KEhZEdtSNBz8V7hAubL49SbOh_KwuH2TY2EDauBLCFCN7-ETqG8zHO4TJufIipuC0dlxiqoyfXAlx17s5juzk9yLxcH-HrzpKSkx-eKh8EYu12K04HWe6i02F-NkG0bOXMw%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That's because we're seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! Ukraine just fired missiles into Russia. A few days ago, the Ukrainian military fired NATO-supplied missiles _at Russian civilians_ – inside Russia. President Biden secretly approved the attack.
President Biden has done nothing to stop this war. Why hasn’t he picked up the phone and talked to Putin? Bringing about a peaceful resolution takes courage and leadership, something Biden lacks.
Taking a stand when it matters most requires courage, wisdom, and the kind of prescient leadership RFK Jr.'s uncle, JFK, exercised during the Cuban missile crisis. He picked up the phone! That’s the kind of _‘peace-first’ fearless leadership_ he will bring.
The Military Industrial Complex, the war machine controlling the politicians in Washington D.C., is determined to get our country and NATO into war with Russia.
We have a war in Europe, a war in the Middle East, and we are edging closer to war with China over Taiwan. We are being dragged into WWIII, which will likely end with nuclear proliferation.
President Biden and President Trump can’t stand up to the Military Industrial Complex and their allies in the DC bureaucracy. RFK Jr. can and will!
We need a President who is unafraid to challenge the Military Industrial Complex, the DC bureaucracy, and the politicians profiting off war. We need a President unafraid to challenge even his most trusted advisors when it is in the best interest of the American people – Like his uncle did during the Cuban missile crisis.
It’s time to put another Kennedy in the White House!

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ad7c44a514434dbbbd7b7060fce0e84e&_e=I--_oEAs3sGqGUAenJREF5R90HgHQzN-h8M3_kee8rvxeevCbAOlZ5q9QFoTh31NHhzmByvDglydJ5QOtuCEUnskg5ky6w7xKoHqmxNR1O0i0Xl5s2ju5aZiSn69X57slMm8OWmfKi65CVdM-PB49Y1QalsuTXsGgxKeAAWQRN8LxwPOHsEQ41jRdIIzuI4XhIcnVIHig4qVSR5J1q-LpvxZt47KYOKlyVWBVRZreNT0m0eAtBB3HXH1AfvATdpzmHiqbkdzkUjfOEDidtBl-RL3LCRtdKZwkhi0ihwlXdncfheivF8KqrESk3EEdgcw94bcjBYHzfGIrvGXgBUan6ehkbLNFT3ojpJRR0D1jz0BgWQQBNjQ2mRKCXlgLdXszzRieX6hbK1kNVxCeFOpMy97zA5E9n9863e9karq1uaOztGNg842_u0NNnLwCu6vzBEetHZrlyHnhmC-wB9eQQ%3D%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ad7c44a514434dbbbd7b7060fce0e84e&_e=I--_oEAs3sGqGUAenJREF5R90HgHQzN-h8M3_kee8rvxeevCbAOlZ5q9QFoTh31NHhzmByvDglydJ5QOtuCEUnskg5ky6w7xKoHqmxNR1O0i0Xl5s2ju5aZiSn69X57slMm8OWmfKi65CVdM-PB49Y1QalsuTXsGgxKeAAWQRN8LxwPOHsEQ41jRdIIzuI4XhIcnVIHig4qVSR5J1q-LpvxZt47KYOKlyVWBVRZreNT0m0eAtBB3HXH1AfvATdpzmHiqbkdzkUjfOEDidtBl-RL3LCRtdKZwkhi0ihwlXdncfheivF8KqrESk3EEdgcwgP6vvoxIuukyPgrJk2Cyh0b5Yto4uLMMlhIMIiTVaqMSbzYBvgi4BPINrW89ArbwBwWz5v9JSpDfbq3vDYAfPBx2_8gMBo-DzMmJ_O0tSe6-nWQVxti5r5wmqg8ioOp4xzCSLHCbhahEuRA0CXygMg%3D%3D "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 6/5/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, June 5, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Primary Election'24: In 5th District, both Democratic and Republican races are opposed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In [Colorado's 5th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), both Republican and Democratic registered voters will be asked to weigh in on contested races for their party's nomination to the general election ballot.
U.S. Rep. Doug Lamborn announced earlier this year his decision to retire at the conclusion of his term, setting up an [open-seat election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the central and southern Colorado district.
Ballots began hitting the mailstream Monday in the state's primary election and must be mailed to all registered voters by Friday. [Election Day is June 25.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In the 5th District Republican Party primary election, the decision is between [Jeff Crank and Dave Williams](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Crank twice previously opposed Lamborn for the seat and the vice president of Americans for Prosperity is back for another run against Williams, the chairman of the Colorado Republican Party. Williams also previously ran unsuccessfully against Lamborn. Read the [Colorado Sun's candidate questionnaire](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the 5th District race.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**['Laptop from hell' among evidence facing Hunter Biden in gun trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Hunter Biden's [gun crime trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) resumed with FBI Special Agent Erika Jensen presenting evidence from Biden's text messages and other sources.
* Prosecutors detailed Hunter Biden's illegal activities, including crack cocaine use and communications with a drug dealer, which occurred shortly after he [purchased a gun](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The trial included a tense moment where Hunter's wife, Melissa Cohen Biden, confronted a former Trump aide in court, and the prosecution introduced [Hunter's laptop as evidence](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to support their case.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Candidate conflict unfolds at Congressional District 5 debate hosted by The Gazette, KOAA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The debate at Centennial Hall, hosted by The Gazette and KOAA, saw [significant conflict](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between Republican candidates Jeff Crank and Dave Williams, overshadowing other discussions.
* [Democratic candidates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) River Gassen and Joe Reagan discussed their professional backgrounds and policy approaches, contrasting with the heated exchanges among their Republican counterparts.
* [Key issues debated](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) included strategies for affordable housing in Colorado Springs, maintaining local military assets, and national immigration policy.
* The debate was marked by moments of disorder, reflecting the intense rivalry and [differing visions for the district](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) among the candidates.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Air Force dangles big bucks, expands eligibility for retention bonuses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AIR FORCE TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Air Force has [increased retention bonuses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to $180,000 to encourage airmen in critical roles to reenlist, up from a previous cap of $100,000.
* 'The number of [eligible career fields](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for these bonuses has expanded to 73, including new additions like air traffic controllers and cyber defense superintendents.
* New policies allow airmen to [reenlist for up to eight years](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and start the reenlistment process a year before their current term ends, enhancing flexibility and retention efforts.
* These changes aim to address recruitment challenges and [ensure the retention of skilled personnel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in vital military capacities.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[No veterans living on Denver streets? That's Mayor Mike Johnston's goal.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver Mayor Mike Johnston aims to [eliminate veteran homelessness](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the city by the end of the year, targeting housing for 52 identified homeless veterans.
* The initiative collaborates with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and uses HUD-VASH vouchers to help [secure permanent housing through partnerships](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with local organizations like Volunteers of America Colorado and Community Solutions.
* Despite city efforts, critics argue the provided housing solutions [lack stability](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), emphasizing the need for more permanent options.
* The plan is part of a [broader national effort](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) under the White House's initiative to end homelessness, aiming to reduce bureaucratic barriers and improve service delivery.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Stratford: What does human trafficking look like in Colorado?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SABRINA STRATFORD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | COMMENTARY
_There are more than 49.6 million people in modern slavery today. What does that look like in Colorado?_
_Human trafficking is the exploitation of another person involving force, fraud, or coercion for labor or sex. Human trafficking is a crime against a person, not a border. Anyone can become a victim, no matter a person 's background or identity, but the more vulnerable a person is the more likely they are to become a victim._
_At risk individuals include those living on the streets or homeless, individuals with addictions, sex workers, the LGBTQIA+ community, runaways and immigrants. At risk people are trafficked more frequently than safe and stable community members._
_Sex trafficking Involves the recruitment, harboring, transportation, provision, or obtaining of a person for the purpose of a commercial sex act. Labor trafficking is the same, but instead of a sex act, specifically, it involves involuntary servitude, slavery or debt bondage. Human trafficking is occurring in all 50 states and it 's happening across Colorado in both rural and urban areas. It's taking place in food service and hospitality, construction, agriculture, the commercial sex industry, temporary worker and visa programs, in debt bondage scenarios to pay off smugglers, in involuntarily servitude and forced marriages, and in family homes._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Special district elections: RTD board will have elections to eight district seats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL | JUNE 3** _Non-partisan elections of persons who sit on city councils, school districts, fire and water boards, and more, almost always are overshadowed in what is termed "down-ballot elections."_
**[Ballots to begin hitting mailstream for June 25 primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER** **| STATE | JUNE 3** _Ballots will begin hitting the mailstream today, June 3, in the state 's primary election, Secretary of State Jena Griswold has announced. Election Day is Tuesday, June 25._
**[Zorn: Colorado's passenger rail romance vs. reality](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RYAN ZORN**** | COMMENTARY | JUNE 3** _Have you noticed that the expansion of passenger rail is beginning to permeate agendas of state and local governments? The romance of big rail projects and access to other people's money have always been hard for career politicians to resist. _**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

Friend,

I can't tell you how much it means to me that you opened this. Did you know that only about 20-30% of folks open these messages from me?

I do have to ask a quick favor of you - I'm simply asking you to read this all the way through. If you finish reading this and you still think a $1 donation doesn't matter, then I want to just say **[thank you for hearing me out.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z69j6ej8o9sc212p78f5oluqf4cd0v7d58dks0bg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

While only about 25% of our friends are opening messages from me and my team, **[only about 1%](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zb0ulnh8119t4gibk19o8msufd4c5c3vft7mb7hg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)** will go the extra mile by donating! I'm not exaggerating when I say this, Friend, conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with supporters like you.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires that I can call on to hit these goals. **[I rely on the couple of bucks that hard-working Americans receiving these messages can afford to give me from time to time.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z4i01t741onl5p1ijg0ar4251hapl55rmu3t9ps8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit - even just $1 - we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' _MASSIVE_ campaign coffers.

**[I'll be honest...](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zd8ksqj9ukv3br29jc93gr82sr6bktd0c655k8go_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs) **

The Democrats were able to stop our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit of support we can get if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today. If we're going to stay on pace to reach all of our goals, I truly need your help.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zpu9uq7p0dfefist3k0j4gqm0clus6eqgcrpde68_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)

**[I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a single cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a jelly doughnut. The Democrats rely on billionaire megadonors who give thousands at a time, but I rely on folks like you who can give $3, $9, or even $18.25 to reach my next crucial Goal.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zbmda167v40qclcuh0aofnqt82si0jhbk08cu9kg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

**[☕CHIP IN THE PRICE OF A CUP OF COFFEE☕](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zc7pbufp50cu89p0tebhe99cngo76csemgdtu72g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

_Democrats are hoping I give up on you.

They're hoping you give up on me.

They're hoping both of us give up on conservative values altogether. _

We can't let them run this country into the ground. I'm rolling up my sleeves and continuing to work for hard-working families like yours - making our country better, stronger, and safer.

I hope you won't quit on me or our shared values. I know a lot of folks are going to ignore this, but I **[need](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9379g668fmf828rrsb515sfalks94o8fgj62um0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)** patriots like you to see what's at stake. If you think you're better off than you were 5 years ago, then I understand why you don't want to donate today.

**[But if you think we need to get this country back on track and restore the American Dream, please donate whatever you can afford before midnight.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zahnmcmg3b7kb4n2u8p8vp0t6au3hh3ci8pom3t0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

**[DONATE TODAY](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z2bp15ntpmbe5qmb12co8aidaunemf7tuj1a7ap0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdg64pj6cth2bs)**

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=382141ffb7454eb08f617b972691074e&_e=6OCaIRhJLlIM-teYwLWSB4ph6rIKGWJ3EE-OxuqNZmCjFPtJxyjNfJ9D6kjUZyk_7mCPTprv9XmUTah6L6zzd_N_zTuVum2PPFBiINMas0jN02mM-xwL_2DuJ-brlkKVaW6odnFfus2ZQcSS5th4hXMKSlbmgLQTNp8qgpr8z4ZxUy4TKPvpwijTP2ew6toaTlxusaNHVqG8CbMFGk-k0InIUcQUSPdtq9GWERE4KWEhAlxnMiNNrRNXctcFtMX_)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=382141ffb7454eb08f617b972691074e&_e=6OCaIRhJLlIM-teYwLWSB4ph6rIKGWJ3EE-OxuqNZmCjFPtJxyjNfJ9D6kjUZyk_7mCPTprv9XmUTah6L6zzd_N_zTuVum2PPFBiINMas0iFqXKOUeWeBvlGy9hbyanqVZAzr8j_yAceLE5aCMteGE42dezC9-ZHgHWhjlq4uW5hWufTsN8dSQw6HFyn61hehPz8ydPCVvSSKxLn2lH0g9ul-c0UIDChr_EwMvfuzMmtbJRWIE8oYJCUsIuTJZLi)

Hey Peter, it’s Jon Tester. It’s official: **We’re facing off against Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate Tim Sheehy.**
The general election has officially begun in Montana, and one thing is already clear: **My opponent and I couldn’t be more different.**
* Tim Sheehy grew up in a multi-million dollar lake house in the big city suburbs. I’m a third-generation dirt farmer, born and raised in Montana.
* Tim Sheehy supports a national abortion ban. I'm fighting to protect personal freedoms.
* Tim Sheehy will be a mouthpiece for Mitch McConnell’s agenda. I always take my cues from Montanans.

**[This race will be decided by a mere handful of votes, so every action we take could be the difference between victory and defeat. Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Bob Casey to help power us to victory?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240605-1?refcode=em20240605-1&refcode2=3154_552475_lvYbyf&akid=3154%2E552475%2ElvYbyf)**
Whether he’s playing cowboy or pretending he grew up surrounded by farmland, Tim Sheehy is shamelessly lying when it’s clear he doesn’t understand a lick about what makes rural America so special.
**Montana deserves a senator that appreciates everything that makes our state the Last Best Place—that’s why we have to win this race.**
This seat is on track to become the most expensive and competitive Senate race in the country. Outside groups are spending nearly $65 million on attacks trying to turn me into someone I’m not—because they can’t beat who I am. **I need your help to fight back, so I’m asking:**

Thank you,
Jon

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Untitled%20design.png]
Bergman is the top House spender for taxpayer funded lodging and food reimbursements
To address the financial burden of maintaining two residences — one in their home district and one in the capital — Congresspeople are eligible for reimbursement for living expenses, including lodging and food.
But, my opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman is abusing his privileges.
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
My campaign is entirely grassroots funded. Bergman has windfall benefits and outspends most in self promotion.
Even though our campaign's in-district schedule is 200x more demanding than Bergman's, I almost always pay for my own meals, gas, and lodging while on the road. I will continue being a good steward of your investments. [drbob.me/aboutbob]
CONTRIBUTE [drbob.me/aboutbob]
Friends,
Daily meal expenses for Congressmembers are limited to $79, and lodging caps vary depending on the month, from $172 to $258 per day.
Rep. Jack Bergman (R-Mich.) is the program's top spender. In 2023, he was reimbursed more than $32,000 for lodging and nearly $12,000 for meals. These funds come from the Congressional budget, which taxpayers fund.
There is a significant disparity. As a public servant, Rep. Bergman receives financial assistance from taxpayers to cover his DC apartment rent. His primary residence in Louisiana is valued at $750,000, and his summer cottage in the UP is valued at $1 million. Bergman's financial stability with multiple government pensions raises questions about the need for such high reimbursements.
It's disheartening enough that by claiming a "homestead" in the UP, Rep. Bergman is exempt from paying school taxes to Gogebic County, depriving local public schools of $4,754 annually. This is a significant loss for a community where many struggle with poverty and every dollar counts.
It's hard to reconcile. Bergman claims meals of $79 a day, but he's voted against food stamps for people experiencing poverty.
Why can't Rep. Bergman make it financially with his sizable military pension, Social Security, private pension, investments, and $174,000 salary? Does he need taxpayers' help paying for his meals?
While Rep. Bergman enjoys a comfortable financial situation, our district's constituents, who make 20% less per household than the national average, grapple with the high cost of living.
Our district is plagued by childhood poverty and low wages that can't sustain a family. The residents he represents live in counties with the highest unemployment rates in Michigan, where finding affordable housing, childcare, or medical care is a constant struggle.
We need a change. I am running to defeat Bergman because I am fighting for our families, freedoms, and futures, not my own personal gain.
Friends, please join our fight. [drbob.me/aboutbob]
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

According to Stephen Moore's newsletter, The Committee to Unleash Prosperity, when looking at income gains for minorities between this Administration and the last - minorities fared much better under Trump.

"Bidenomics" is a failure!

The downfall of Roe didn’t happen overnight. Anti-choice extremists have been chipping at it for decades, working against it in state legislatures, installing anti-abortion judges, and of course Donald Trump appointing one third of the Supreme Court.
