I know this piece may upset some of my readers, but my job as a human rights lawyer is not to play favorites with politicians, but to uphold justice in all matters. And today, I must speak up for justice for asylum seekers, and clearly state that President Biden's executive order to restrict asylum is a direct affront to the very legal and humanitarian principles that he campaigned on. Making the matter worse is the avalanche of misinformation on what asylum is, and is not. It is crucial to address and correct the several misconceptions being used to justify this harmful policy.
Below I quickly address six common misunderstandings about asylum. I hope you read and share this with your network to better combat the plethora of misinformation that is making meaningful immigration reform even more difficult to achieve.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xNa-kXtUt0w-UkvbsHA2_2bQS1puXW2r7NSaRHS7zT4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145326197)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/78270a49-870e-4411-8ab0-81e77f22c31d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Joe Biden announces an executive order on enforcement at the U.S.-Mexico border, in the East Room of the White House in Washington, D.C., June 4, 2024.(Leah Millis/Reuters)
1. **Asylum is legal immigration, period.**

On June 4, the White House [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/56f61b8f-7ae0-45d2-ac78-5448bae856af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "[President Biden] is announcing new executive actions to bar migrants who cross our Southern border unlawfully from receiving asylum." This is a flawed statement, because asylum itself is legal immigration and there exists no unlawful way to cross our Southern border (or any border) to seek asylum. In other words, the correct way to apply for asylum is precisely to cross the border and seek asylum. This is literally [on the USCIS website right now](https://substack.com/redirect/b32515d8-3152-4f31-b8ea-1c7a658192c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5620a5b-4b70-4eb7-b5a0-19616189d11d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This right to asylum is a recognized and protected right under both U.S. and international law. Individuals who seek asylum are doing so in accordance with legal provisions established to protect those fleeing persecution and violence.
2. **Asylum seekers do not need a visa to enter the United States.**

The very nature of asylum is to provide refuge to those who are unable to obtain visas because they are fleeing immediate danger or persecution. Imposing a visa requirement on asylum seekers would be contrary to the purpose of asylum laws, and would put in danger the lives of those seeking safety from direct threats of violence to their persons. (This is also why the legal and correct way to seek asylum is to get to the United States safely and _then_ seek asylum).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xNa-kXtUt0w-UkvbsHA2_2bQS1puXW2r7NSaRHS7zT4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145326197)
3. **Asylum seekers and refugees are two different types of applicants.**

An asylum seeker and a refugee are two entirely different types of applicants, and go through two entirely different immigration processes. As the USCIS [explains](https://substack.com/redirect/4b645f54-6ca9-4278-85f3-d3f2b612a8e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while both refugees and asylum seekers apply for their respective immigration from outside of their home countries, a person may only seek refugee status from outside the United States, while seeking asylum requires you are present in the United States.
Refugees go through an incredible detailed background check and security check before they are accepted as refugees. Asylum seekers already in the country are thoroughly vetted by an immigration judge before their asylum is granted. This distinction is important because, as I discuss below, Biden's executive order does nothing to decrease the legitimate need for asylum that those in need seek.
4. **There is no "designated port" or "first country" requirement for asylum seekers.**

These two claims are most often cited by anti-immigrant activists, and they're wrong on both counts. U.S. law permits individuals to seek asylum regardless of how they enter the country, and even if they passed through another country to reach the United States. This is codified in both the Universal Declaration of Human Rights Article 14 and in U.S. Code Section 1158(a)(1). For example, Section 1158(a)(1) clearly [states](https://substack.com/redirect/6f6c79c2-8a72-4902-b1f8-236cdf394dd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> §1158\. Asylum (a) Authority to apply for asylum (1) In general
> Any alien who is physically present in the United States or who arrives in the United States (**whether or not at a designated port of arrival** **and including an alien who is brought to the United States after having been interdicted in international or United States waters**), irrespective of such alien's status, may apply for asylum in accordance with this section.
So, to further reiterate a point made earlier, crossing the border into the United States without documentation or by passing through a third country to get to the United States does nothing to restrict a person's legal right to apply for asylum once they are in the United States.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xNa-kXtUt0w-UkvbsHA2_2bQS1puXW2r7NSaRHS7zT4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145326197)
5. **Asylum approval isn 't an automatic designation and there aren't billions of people pouring in.**

A MAGA conservative tweeted at me, "What if all 8 billion people on Earth want asylum in America. How many should we accept?" Notwithstanding that 8 billion people most definitely do _not_ want to come to the United States, seeking asylum also doesn't mean automatic approval. That process involves a detailed legal assessment of claims and circumstances, ensuring that those who genuinely need protection receive it. A judge reviews the claim, ensures it meets the strict criteria, and approves only those who meet the criteria. And no, 8 billion people are not at our door seeking asylum. Since 2000, roughly 40% of asylum cases have been granted--a number totaling [about 700,000](https://substack.com/redirect/df78b8f0-18e1-4989-bf74-66e2e12a97a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Notably, there is no such thing as "economic asylum" (as the right claims exists). Those who meet the criteria are vetted and approved after a thorough process. Those who do not meet the criteria face deportation. And far from 8 billion, the 700,000 granted asylum applications over the last two plus decades account for about .016% of the U.S. population. That doesn't exactly scream "invasion" as some claim in their cruel attempts to dehumanize asylum seekers.
6. **There 's no evidence that restricting asylum will alleviate the immigration crisis.**

Finally, and perhaps worst of all, there's little evidence this executive order will do anything to improve our broken immigration system. I have processed asylum claims for my entire career as an attorney. No one legitimately seeking asylum ever wished to leave their home country, travel thousands of miles, risk life and limb--all for the fun of it. They do so out of desperation because all other options have failed. By denying this process, this right, we undermine the legal frameworks designed to protect the most vulnerable, and damning them to horrific persecution, rape, or murder. And this is not hyperbole. As I addressed in an [MSNBC interview way back in 2021](https://substack.com/redirect/d9dde839-3347-45b4-af4d-c82fcb35b4a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "The Human Rights Campaign did a study and found over 1,500 people that the US deported without hearing their asylum claim were either raped, murdered, or tortured."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d9dde839-3347-45b4-af4d-c82fcb35b4a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Biden knows this and himself acknowledged the importance of protecting asylum seekers when he was running for President. On July 26, 2019, he [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/9ab37c85-232e-4a88-ae0d-85d4ff2a1d72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Trump is fighting tooth & nail to deny those fleeing dangerous situations their right to seek asylum in our nation. We should uphold our moral responsibility & enforce our immigration laws with dignity--not turn away those fleeing violence, war, & poverty.
His executive order today starkly contradicts his own stance and campaign promises, representing a significant and troubling departure from his commitment to humane immigration policies. Instead of closing doors, we should focus on actual solutions that uphold our values, such as hiring more immigration judges and attorneys to process asylum claims efficiently, and fully funding USCIS to address the massive immigration backlog.
**In Conclusion**
As citizens, we must not shy away from calling out this hypocrisy and demanding justice for immigrants and asylum seekers. It is our moral and legal obligation to ensure that those fleeing persecution can access the protections they are entitled to. California Senator Alex Padilla said it well in his statement on Biden's ‪executive order:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b669f4c4-3c4c-4f05-bde1-ee6e95c27c16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We must always remember that asylum laws were codified to prevent tragedies like that of the S.S. St. Louis, a ship carrying Jewish refugees fleeing Nazi persecution that the United States turned away in 1939. The 1000+ refugees were forced to return to Europe, where at least 254 perished in the Holocaust. This dark chapter in history underscores the vital importance of providing a safe haven to those in desperate need. We must remember these lessons and ensure that our policies reflect compassion, justice, and respect for human rights. President Biden ran on undoing Trump's cruel asylum bans, and it is critical we hold him accountable to his word.

This is codified in both the Universal Declaration of Human Rights Article 14 and in U.S. Code Section 1158(a)(1). For example, Section 1158(a)(1) clearly : §1158\. Asylum (a) Authority to apply for asylum (1) In general Any alien who is physically present in the United States or who arrives in the United States (whether or not at a designated port of arrival and including an alien who is brought to the United States after having been interdicted in international or United States waters), irrespective of such alien's status, may apply for asylum in accordance with this section. So, to further reiterate a point made earlier, crossing the border into the United States without documentation or by passing through a third country to get to the United States does nothing to restrict a person's legal right to apply for asylum once they are in the United States. 5. Asylum approval isn 't an automatic designation and there aren't billions of people pouring in. A MAGA conservative tweeted at me, "What if all 8 billion people on Earth want asylum in America. How many should we accept?" Notwithstanding that 8 billion people most definitely do not want to come to the United States, seeking asylum also doesn't mean automatic approval. That process involves a detailed legal assessment of claims and circumstances, ensuring that those who genuinely need protection receive it. A judge reviews the claim, ensures it meets the strict criteria, and approves only those who meet the criteria. And no, 8 billion people are not at our door seeking asylum. Since 2000, roughly 40% of asylum cases have been granted--a number totaling . Notably, there is no such thing as "economic asylum" (as the right claims exists). Those who meet the criteria are vetted and approved after a thorough process. Those who do not meet the criteria face deportation. And far from 8 billion, the 700,000 granted asylum applications over the last two plus decades account for about .016% of the U.S. population. That doesn't exactly scream "invasion" as some claim in their cruel attempts to dehumanize asylum seekers. 6. There 's no evidence that restricting asylum will alleviate the immigration crisis. Finally, and perhaps worst of all, there's little evidence this executive order will do anything to improve our broken immigration system. I have processed asylum claims for my entire career as an attorney. No one legitimately seeking asylum ever wished to leave their home country, travel thousands of miles, risk life and limb--all for the fun of it. They do so out of desperation because all other options have failed. By denying this process, this right, we undermine the legal frameworks designed to protect the most vulnerable, and damning them to horrific persecution, rape, or murder. And this is not hyperbole. As I addressed in an , "The Human Rights Campaign did a study and found over 1,500 people that the US deported without hearing their asylum claim were either raped, murdered, or tortured." | | ---|---|--- President Biden knows this and himself acknowledged the importance of protecting asylum seekers when he was running for President. On July 26, 2019, he : Trump is fighting tooth & nail to deny those fleeing dangerous situations their right to seek asylum in our nation. We should uphold our moral responsibility & enforce our immigration laws with dignity--not turn away those fleeing violence, war, & poverty. His executive order today starkly contradicts his own stance and campaign promises, representing a significant and troubling departure from his commitment to humane immigration policies. Instead of closing doors, we should focus on actual solutions that uphold our values, such as hiring more immigration judges and attorneys to process asylum claims efficiently, and fully funding USCIS to address the massive immigration backlog. In Conclusion As citizens, we must not shy away from calling out this hypocrisy and demanding justice for immigrants and asylum seekers. It is our moral and legal obligation to ensure that those fleeing persecution can access the protections they are entitled to. California Senator Alex Padilla said it well in his statement on Biden's ‪executive order: | | ---|---|--- We must always remember that asylum laws were codified to prevent tragedies like that of the S.S. St. Louis, a ship carrying Jewish refugees fleeing Nazi persecution that the United States turned away in 1939. The 1000+ refugees were forced to return to Europe, where at least 254 perished in the Holocaust. This dark chapter in history underscores the vital importance of providing a safe haven to those in desperate need. We must remember these lessons and ensure that our policies reflect compassion, justice, and respect for human rights. President Biden ran on undoing Trump's cruel asylum bans, and it is critical we hold him accountable to his word. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. subject: Remembering the origin of Pride.

As we step into this vibrant and vital time of year, we celebrate all of the LGBTQIA+ members of our St. Louis community who enrich our district every single day.
But, Peter — Pride Month is not just a celebration; it is a commemoration of a struggle. We must never forget that Pride started as a protest against police violence and LGBTQIA+ discrimination. So let me be clear, this month is the result of organizing, uprising, and activism rooted in the Stonewall Uprising. Fifty-four years after Stonewall, we are still fighting the GOP’s extremist efforts to restrict the rights of our LGBTQIA+ community...
I, for one, have made it my mission to fight every day to reject the GOP's attacks against the LGBTQIA+ community and push for a more just, inclusive, and equitable society.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_060524_pride [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_060524_pride] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_060524_pride [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_060524_pride]
In Missouri and across the country, we are witnessing a terrifying rise in anti-trans legislation and hate crimes. But our movement is a movement of love, and together we are advocating for policies which proudly declare that Trans Lives Matter and Black Trans Lives Matter. And I will keep emphasizing the need to protect and uplift these communities, because every person has the right to live their life as their true, authentic selves.
Our collective fight for justice and freedom is why I support H.R. 15, the Equality Act, which seeks to provide consistent and explicit anti-discrimination protections for LGBTQIA+ people across key areas of life. And to this day, I am leading the push for the ERA (Equal Rights Amendment) to finally be certified and published, striving for constitutional recognition of gender equality.
So, Peter, can I count on you to donate to my campaign today, so I can continue to lead the charge for equality and advocate for our LGBTQIA+ communities in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_060524_pride]

As we celebrate Pride Month, let's honor the legacy of those who fought before us and commit to carrying their fight forward.
Together, we can create a future where every person has the freedom to truly embrace and celebrate their identity. Where each and every one of us can live freely and authentically.
With Pride and Solidarity 🏳️🌈,
Cori

Now, Cori is running for re-election to continue doing the most for everyone, starting with those who have the greatest need.

body:
I know this message is longer than usual, but it would mean the world if you could take a second to read it.

| |
---
| | | Hi Friend, it's Michelle Steel. I wanted to take a moment to tell you my full story. This message is longer than usual, but I hope that you will read every word.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2qqlre388p2kki6626u57fbjitaicv72vp7u3ko_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

_I'm a wife, mother, immigrant, and an advocate for American families and businesses._

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1f6jq02r5dgehkev7lgn6i4r36plg3r8a72dn00_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

My parents escaped from North Korea in hopes of giving our family a better life. I owe so much to my parents. Despite losing everything to communism, they never gave up. Their courage, bravery, and resilience taught me so much, and I am so grateful for their sacrifices.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6aso85jun2ucmuidn1eg8ufh9kssb5hji2dog0g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

I moved to America as a teenager. My family and I started a small business from the ground up. I watched my mother struggle with tedious government processes,**I realized that the government is failing the people who need it most. **

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zeh8et2bbmfkf3n8afdvpak0f10p68n0je0m1d3o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

I knew then that I wanted to do more to help, so I ran for the California State Board of Equalization and then, the Orange County Board of Supervisors. I was the highest-ranking Korean-American elected official in the country.

**I gave almost $400 million back to California taxpayers, and that put a major target on my back.**

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsva45pes5h5a0u7vj038q1d3v7gsa6ddpu3dldg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

I decided that I wanted to take my fight to Washington, so I ran for Congress in a Democrat-held seat. I defied all odds and by the skin of my teeth, I won. My race was one of the most hard-fought in the country. 2022 was more of the same, but we won again and helped take back the House Majority.

I'll be blunt, Friend, without your support, my campaign is in major trouble. _**[I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can't fight back without your support.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7jucree7ljh0v0k2rujt8vqd60c3olt4mprcndo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs "I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can’t fight back without your support.")**_

The White House, House Democrats, and several far-Left have all named me a TOP target. Biden even came to California twice to personally raise money against California Republicans like me.

I am personally asking for just $10 to keep my fight alive. _**[Will you stand with me?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5q5kmsc1lspp90huf13on6ildrjdgn5td5b1p08_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs "Will you stand with me?")**_

---
| | [STAND WITH MICHELLE](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjk3umkjs60qv7jjnss32emv3n65js1ppds991j0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs "TEST TEST TEST")
---

Thank you for your time and consideration,

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq9m6q7o53mu7paft8gmj4c93h9dfv1ge5ce9gjo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs)
---

Michelle Steel (CA-45)

P.S. I know that times are tough for so many Americans. If you can't afford to give right now, __**[it would mean a lot if you would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdnau8kgv523lqd6pp2344lbnh8k0vvoe3rjuog8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi60ob2cdh2bs "it would mean a lot if you would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.")**__

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Don Tracy Ally Jeanne Ives Attacks Grassroots on Facebook as Powerful Voter Base Abandons Angry Radio Host (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Jeanne Ives on March 2, 2018. (Andy Abeyta/Quad-City Times)

By Illinois Review
On Monday, Illinois Republican State Central Committee member Jeanne Ives – a close ally to embattled IL GOP chairman Don Tracy – went on Facebook to publicly slam her own constituents – the conservative grassroots base of the party – for emailing and asking about an incident that took place during the state convention – angrily posting, “canned emails get a canned response.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Earlier on Monday, the powerful and influential base of the Republican Party – the grassroots – sent emails to IL GOP leaders including Ives, asking why SSC member Mark Shaw – who was running for national committeeman – was spotted wearing a “delegate” badge during the state convention when he was not an actual delegate. As a delegate, Shaw could vote for himself for national committeeman – a vote that wouldn’t help, as he would lose the election in a landslide (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/grassroots-dominate-il-gop-state-convention-and-expand-influence-as-state-party-leaders-lose-their-cool.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to the grassroots-backed candidate Dean White. But growing agitated by the influx of emails concerning Shaw, Ives decided to go on her Facebook page and post a comment that read, “You send a canned email, you get a canned response...at least I replied to your canned email.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-on-facebook-as-powerful-voter-base-abandons-angry-radio-host.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8915514884-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The comment drew an immediate backlash as Republicans fired back calling Ives’ comment “ignorant” and “belittling” to the constituents she’s supposed to represent. In her “canned” reply, Ives stated “Thank you for contacting me. This email is to confirm that I received your input and to let you know that I will look into the matter. Jeanne Ives, IL 3rd SCC.”

| | | | Look, my wife Aly and I share the work of running our household and raising our boys evenly, but to be perfectly honest with you, my smile is forced in this picture – **I hate doing laundry.**
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tx_allred_split?refcode=laundry)
---
| But here's one laundry list even I can get behind: the list of reasons we need to fire Ted Cruz:
* **Ted Cruz viciously attacks our fundamental rights and reproductive freedoms** – even though six in 10 Texans support abortion access.
* **Texans deserve a leader who will fight for them** – rather than podcasting three times a week or running off to vacation when he's needed most.
* **Ted Cruz has parroted dangerous, far-right conspiracy theories** that endanger the safety and accessibility of our democracy for working Texans.

Listen, Ted Cruz has a lot of dirty laundry – and I could keep going on for pages and pages. **But the bottom line is this: Texans can't afford six more years of an extremist like Ted Cruz. Not when he's proven that his loyalties lie only with the special interests and the mega donors that keep him in power.** Right now, polls show that Ted Cruz and I are neck and neck. We can send him and his dirty laundry packing for good, but it's going to take a huge outpouring of grassroots support to reach the millions of voters we need to win. body:
The gun lobby doesn’t go down without a fight.
#

When we first started our work on gun violence prevention, talking about gun safety on the campaign trail was considered taboo. Even if candidates supported our gun safety movement, they were told they couldn’t bring it up out of fear of retaliation from the gun lobby.
But today, our movement has changed hearts, minds, and the political playbook. Many candidates run with gun safety as one of their key policy priorities—and they win. In 2022, **over 84%** of our endorsed candidates won their elections.
There’s no doubt we’ve made tremendous progress, but the toll of our gun violence crisis is still way too high. Every day too many lives are taken by gun violence because there are still too many politicians in the pocket of the gun lobby who refuse to take action.
[**The only way that will change is if we keep up the pressure. Together. Please contribute $3 right now to send a clear message that our movement is more powerful than the gun lobby.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240605-1-30&t=1&akid=8249%2E3935704%2EQNdZEw)
Yes, it’s true—our movement has significantly shifted public opinion. We know that gun safety is a winning issue. But the gun lobby doesn’t go down without a fight.
Donald Trump, who was just convicted on all 34 of his felony charges, is on the ballot. Extreme MAGA Republicans like Lauren Boebert and Marjorie Taylor Greene are still in Congress. The Supreme Court has swung dramatically to the right.
We cannot afford any complacency. This year, we are preparing the most ambitious campaigns and organizing efforts in our organization’s history. But elections are expensive, so we need your help to make sure we have the resources to do it.
[**Can you please contribute $3 to support our work? Your donation will be directly invested in our plans to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240605-1-30&t=2&akid=8249%2E3935704%2EQNdZEw)

Fellow American,

**_I would be honored if you could spare just one minute to read this heartfelt memo in its entirety. I guarantee it will be well worth your time._ **

**My parents taught me that when you're in trouble, the best thing to do is to tell the truth.**

So here's the unfiltered truth of serving in New York City:

* I'm the last NYC Republican in Congress
* My fundraising numbers are drastically declining
* My district is under attack by radical protests and antisemitism
* More migrants than ever are moving to NYC and can legally squat in our homes

**My friend, I said I'd give you the unfiltered truth.**

**_I'm scared. I'm sad. I'm run down._** But I refuse to give up the hope that led me to serve you in our government in the first place.

I've been wracking my brain for ways to make concrete change in a country where it seems as though one step forward triggers twelve steps back.

| [ **BE A PART OF THE SOLUTION** ](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=c093ac1fc5674c039e2fce02428dcdd4&_e=kRhxRpkKS5hfVeg8nTI1RR87WT8M4a8ihTuRl9ejQQPdWABBSe7F1LSYhVsTjqSIFQ_EeR_YreFnnKtmnBrtKt59-6k3nTgqRcJDBi7MXajouQFsCfL_roH_5tpbnGoLbqDN_qg2qxtiapKowX4fwj4YcNnmFFr8KdZPbKsoerN1IJlPdbDNB5WxluPFBmaJJsnC4Wvwvcq60vb1P2v-MpM-gPNNoTbGaHa85nu7V3sT2nFO50GfSld11XiaHt8yT2qP_WJg5w9AR_XIlW9E8dgD1y2LwcKX3aQtEUx_6QaP1Wl59MehhgqerldHDvnW7ENNiLJBjjFK0J-1tzgrUtcIICgQZNG5xrdO4E359QxIwf1rM6fMCcMKqz7ULX2B9Q9IxNgMbAgwNdV0VVZuQXbfTEgglsbByS-UB1-IWHc%3D)

Let's return to the principles upon which this once-great nation was founded.**Life. Liberty. Happiness. Representation.**

**So please allow me to share my vision:**

* I want open communication with _**ALL Americans**_ , on both sides of the aisle, to encourage fruitful policy change and rational laws in this nation. You have my email– don't be afraid to say hi.
* I wish to inform _**ALL Americans**_ of the truth of the mayhem in our cities and the radical ideas that are pushed upon our youth against their will.
* I hope to inspire a spirit of hope within _**ALL Americans**_ to stand up and make a change in our country.

**We have power in numbers. If you can't relate to my unfiltered truth, I thank you for your attention. You can close this email now.**

**If my truth has inspired you to fight for your nation in any way you can, keep reading.**

Peter,
One school year in the mid-1990s, when I was teaching at Mankato West High School, a group of my students asked if I’d be willing to help them start the school’s first gay-straight alliance.
They were concerned there was an uptick in anti-LGBTQ bullying, and they wanted to do something about it.
My answer was, “absolutely." As a teacher, it was my responsibility to be an ally and do what I could to make sure every student felt safe to be themselves at school.
I think about that day often during Pride Month.
In Congress, I was proud to fight for the repeal of “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell,” push for marriage equality, and stand up to President Trump’s hateful transgender troop ban.
As Governor, I was proud to sign the Trans Refuge Act and a conversion therapy ban into law – sending the clear message that everyone is welcome in Minnesota, while Republicans elsewhere across the country were attacking the rights of the LGTBQ+ community.
Even though we've made a lot of progress since the 1990s, I know the work is not over to ensure that everyone, regardless of who they are or who they love, is treated equally. But my promise to you is this: I'll never back down until it is.
Happy Pride,
Tim Walz

body:
I know this message is longer than usual, but it would mean the world if you could take a second to read it.

| |
---
| | | Hi Friend, it's Michelle Steel. I wanted to take a moment to tell you my full story. This message is longer than usual, but I hope that you will read every word.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zji3i102vd2pjkpts6ou8obh659gggi5l1l23r38_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

_I'm a wife, mother, immigrant, and an advocate for American families and businesses._

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z23v02jo47i1io518105lnaub2ufrnkbmd01cbdg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

My parents escaped from North Korea in hopes of giving our family a better life. I owe so much to my parents. Despite losing everything to communism, they never gave up. Their courage, bravery, and resilience taught me so much, and I am so grateful for their sacrifices.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfp23qdanmc5lgna94gu3mghjqeu2bdf2kppve48_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

I moved to America as a teenager. My family and I started a small business from the ground up. I watched my mother struggle with tedious government processes,**I realized that the government is failing the people who need it most. **

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdlbmj74q4spnm9cqe7rupv9g07rh298alcpm3u0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

I knew then that I wanted to do more to help, so I ran for the California State Board of Equalization and then, the Orange County Board of Supervisors. I was the highest-ranking Korean-American elected official in the country.

**I gave almost $400 million back to California taxpayers, and that put a major target on my back.**

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvm9aab4uh48li4gah9f7aj12quf023ik2ct9dvg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

I decided that I wanted to take my fight to Washington, so I ran for Congress in a Democrat-held seat. I defied all odds and by the skin of my teeth, I won. My race was one of the most hard-fought in the country. 2022 was more of the same, but we won again and helped take back the House Majority.

I'll be blunt, Friend, without your support, my campaign is in major trouble. _**[I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can't fight back without your support.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0lutaba5moohhoai4sk4p4bfc1be2sstqmcbsk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs "I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can’t fight back without your support.")**_

The White House, House Democrats, and several far-Left have all named me a TOP target. Biden even came to California twice to personally raise money against California Republicans like me.

I am personally asking for just $10 to keep my fight alive. _**[Will you stand with me?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv2oukpn1an7ehlgppcb8ob74r96rcdg3pqdudi0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs "Will you stand with me?")**_

---
| | [STAND WITH MICHELLE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5g91b29n0fut2f4mb7qeiplqh3fpjm06m5n9a48_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs "TEST TEST TEST")
---

Thank you for your time and consideration,

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf7pfn7ki70873m6i2b6u0ueb2avg9gl3tiah4n0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs)
---

Michelle Steel (CA-45)

P.S. I know that times are tough for so many Americans. If you can't afford to give right now, __**[it would mean a lot if you would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmkcijktitddav3308p7qlq2pq4clrov0d49gm2g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37cdi64oj2cjh2bs "it would mean a lot if you would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.")**__

---

name: Esau Freeman
subject: Our kids deserve better
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/110929/images/EsauFreeman-Logo_RGB-Horiz.png]
Hello,
I want to take a moment to share my views on an under-discussed issue in our country: improving the state of public education.
Our forefathers knew that public education was the key to a strong Republic. Public education has been a great opportunity to level the playing field, so that all citizens have a more equal opportunity to succeed and achieve the American dream.
Public education teaches the similar concepts that most of our society is based upon for individuals to become autonomous adults who can function and make their own way through our ever-changing society. The fundamental building blocks of reading, writing, math and social interaction help to instill and create a national unity based on values, principles and techniques that make American workers the great workforce that we are.
However, we can do better. According to the Century Foundation, US schools are underfunded by nearly $150 billion per year. Our community schools are especially underfunded, and our kids deserve better. We must invest in our public education system to ensure tomorrow’s future.
You get what you pay for and if we are unwilling to invest the time, the energy, the talent, and the finances to ensure that students have the skills they need to remain the strongest and best country in the world. We cannot continue to settle for the underfunding and the intentional neglect of our public education system.
If you agree our kids deserve better, will you donate $10 or more to help us defeat Ron Estes and bring better leadership to DC? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/esauem?refcode=schooling]

Derek -- We've sent a number of fundraising emails, so we thought it important to just pause for a moment to explain why these messages are so important and what they mean to Democrats' success this fall. First, there is no organization better positioned to support Democrats up and down the ballot than the Democratic National Committee. It's in the name. We have the ability to run ads and allocate resources where they are needed, when they are needed -- including to state, local, and federal campaigns and state parties. But what you may not know is that the overwhelming majority of donations we receive come from lots and lots of people chipping in what they can, whenever they can. And a good chunk of those come in response to emails... just like this one. So when you see us make a difference in the presidential race, when you see us moving money to state parties before an election, it's the response to messages like this one that make it happen. Now we don't expect you to donate to every email we send, that would be too much. But with Trump and the RNC announcing record fundraising, we do hope you'll make today the day you chip in your first $7 to the DNC. [Can Joe Biden and Democrats everywhere count on you to contribute $7 directly to the Democratic National Committee? Of the nearly $3 billion in humanitarian aid that the United States
has given Afghanistan since the 2021 military withdraw at least $11
million—and likely a lot more—has gone to the Taliban, according
to a new federal audit that reveals the U.S. “has continued to be
the largest international donor supporting the Afghan people since the
former Afghan government collapsed and the Taliban returned to power
in August 2021.” The terrorist group has taken the millions in
humanitarian and development assistance intended to help the people of
Afghanistan in the form of taxes, fees, import duties, permit charges,
licenses, or public utility services. The Taliban has probably
received a much bigger chunk of the humanitarian assistance because
the parties involved in the cash giveaway, including federal agencies,
the famously corrupt United Nations and handpicked nonprofits, do not
bother keeping track.

Summer is here and you may remember what that used to consist of: The dreaded book report. This always involved some literary classic like _Fahrenheit 451_ or _Animal Farm_ and made a lot of us put our procrastination to the test.

Friends -
You may have noticed that every so often, Ilhan likes our team to check in with our supporters directly to ask a simple question: **_What are the issues you care about most?**_
Well, it's been a couple of months since we last reached out to ask, and we're hoping for a LOT of responses to that very question today.
[**Can we count on you to take our official Team Ilhan June Issues Survey? It should only take a minute or two of your time, but any input you have is incredibly valuable to our campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/io-em240605-issue-survey/?source=em240605-1-t2&refcode2=1186.791427.c8YheH&akid=1186%2E791427%2Ec8YheH)**

We tend to keep the options on these surveys the same every time we ask, because believe it or not, the responses to them change all the time.
It's your answers — alongside the answers of progressives nationwide — that gives us a better read on where our movement's priorities lie at any given moment.
The more responses we receive, the better Ilhan is able to continue fighting for our shared values in Congress.
That's because whether your top priorities are Medicare for All, combating the climate crisis, ending endless wars or something else entirely — **_it's the issues and our supporters that make our progressive movement so special.**_

| | | | | **Youngkin: "We Are Ending the California Electric Vehicle Mandate in Virginia"

ICYMI:** Governor Glenn Youngkin spoke today following an announcement that he has ended the California electric vehicle mandate in Virginia, saying Virginians should have the freedom to decide what kind of car they drive.

"The idea that governments should be telling Virginians what kind of car they must drive is just simply wrong. The idea that unelected bureaucrats in California should be deciding for Virginians what car they drive is wrong, and finally, unleashing the power of the consumer to, in fact, drive what inventory is carried here and how they are serviced is what free enterprise is all about, and that's what today represents," Youngkin said.

---

| | | First reported by the [Wall Street Journal](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=888f8de8c2a5531faa4f2d0e22386720ac9f8199f409d78af38579a963f97b58898178b6343503c1882804ceec839a12fa61ae54a76817ed92958b634ab0fd49 "Wall Street Journal"), "Virginia is backing away from electric-vehicle requirements that would have forced the state to phase out the sale of new gasoline-powered vehicles by 2035. Gov. Glenn Youngkin, a Republican, said Wednesday that Virginia, starting in 2025, would no longer follow the emissions standards set by California."

"The idea that government should tell people what kind of car they can or can't purchase is fundamentally wrong," Youngkin said. "Virginians deserve the freedom to choose which vehicles best fit the needs of their families and businesses."

This comes as polling shows there is strong bipartisan support among Virginians for ending the California electric vehicle mandate.

As the [Washington Examiner reported](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=888f8de8c2a5531faeaa38c7d9dff825f2d580cecfc411a3861373cf3f73045e05823c27d3acbf512f50df51bdfb2d5f8e09ff9feb82f00c4761b0111aed9eb8 "Washington Examiner reported"), 57% of Virginians - including 54% of Independents and 45% of Democrats - want the California-dictated mandate ended. Among those previously aware the mandate was in place, nearly 70% of Virginians supported ending it.

During the General Assembly session, citizens testified before Senate Democrats - who ultimately ignored their testimony - pleading with the legislature to end this mandate.

"I feel like we have conceded our sovereignty to California. We need to repeal this bill... do not let California representatives enforce laws in Virginia," one citizen said before the committee.

---
Today's announcement also comes after Governor Youngkin made clear during his [State of the Commonwealth Address](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=888f8de8c2a5531fefa4975cef40a230acc012bc67e6efdd04df9054091e84d1d23694c908e32f45bb3fe130b17d448ff0bd5d6a509235624d7335c0e5d3f3bc "State of the Commonwealth Address") that he would protect the freedom of Virginians from California mandates.

"Virginians are in charge of our destiny - no one else. That means we also put power where it belongs - with the people. We must reject the current misguided law that allows California to dictate our vehicle laws. Not only does it defy common sense - Virginians should decide for Virginians," Youngkin said during the address.

Now It Wants Out.")

_" The idea that government should tell people what kind of car they can or can't purchase is fundamentally wrong," Youngkin said. "Virginians deserve the freedom to choose which vehicles best fit the needs of their families and businesses."

Virginia's rejection of California's EV rules comes as consumer demand for zero-emission vehicles has fallen off. Automakers have been recalibrating their plans for new EV models and investments in battery factories to match weaker-than-expected consumer demand. _

[DAILY CALLER: 'Fundamentally Wrong': Virginia Heads For Exit Ramp After Adopting California's 'Out-Of-Touch' EV Rules](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=888f8de8c2a5531fb3b97c5a5f0dcf42e5f8b1d982d959dc833b04f99347b4a063ec15ccc67a0019b5079c0e7b19bcd12ebbcb0ffdfbb9a8b6825b58cd66762b "DAILY CALLER: ‘Fundamentally Wrong’: Virginia Heads For Exit Ramp After Adopting California’s ‘Out-Of-Touch’ EV Rules")

_" Once again, Virginia is declaring independence - this time from a misguided electric vehicle mandate imposed by unelected leaders nearly 3,000 miles away from the Commonwealth," Youngkin said in a statement. "The idea that government should tell people what kind of car they can or can't purchase is fundamentally wrong. Virginians deserve the freedom to choose which vehicles best fit the needs of their families and businesses. The law is clear, and I am proud to announce Virginians will no longer be forced to live under this out-of-touch policy."

Youngkin has opposed the policy because "California's requirements for their citizens should not be a one size fits all solution for Virginia," the governor's staff previously told the Daily Caller News Foundation. Previous efforts by state Republicans to repeal the law linking Virginia to California's standards failed, and legislative avenues to get rid of the rules closed when Democrats cemented control of the state legislature in last fall's elections._

[WASHINGTON EXAMINER: Youngkin ditches California EV rules](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=888f8de8c2a5531fcfeb8fc87af33e7422eb97a6a816a39ebc564ca42e7e062e588e446905484e787ceebe82f62a12dcdcc69a6856948b8b20d118770506d89d "WASHINGTON EXAMINER: Youngkin ditches California EV rules")

_YOUNGKIN DITCHES CALIFORNIA ELECTRIC VEHICLE RULES: Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin announced this morning that Virginia will withdraw from the emissions standards set by California at the end of the year, even though the state legislature failed to pass legislation toward that end.

Youngkin claimed authority to exit the rules on the basis that the standards expire at the end of the year. New rules are set to come into force in 2025 requiring zero-emission vehicles to make up at least 22% of all new car sales in participating states by the end of the year and 100% by 2035. But Youngkin cited a decision from Attorney General Jason Miyares finding that Virginia is not obligated to follow the new standards. _

body:
The rule of law matters in this country - at least it should.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_45&n=1)

Wednesday, June 05, 2024 | Peter -- Last week, Donald Trump was found guilty on 34 felony charges of falsifying business records. At Forward, we believe that the rule of law is a non-negotiable tenet of political life, so we ensure that all our candidates [sign a pledge](https://www.forwardparty.com/pledge/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_45&n=2 "Forward Party candidate pledge") promising to uphold it and defend the Constitution. In these unprecedented times, it's important to protect the systems that ensure everyone is held accountable for their actions. A case was brought, a verdict was rendered, and appeals will be heard. Forward leaders will defend our system of laws against attack and corruption, and abide by their rulings. They will use our systems to litigate issues, rather than trying to strong-arm or make appeals to violence. In short, they will be true leaders.
**[Forward Party Brushes Off Pennsylvania Endorsement Snub](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wJe7Oi2KXzCNE6T3sSKybawz_lfTKbLwknrwqOhoCWHgGYWzNZaXONp0wlNheBFesIs7GlyY8DuZsLJKMBAFhB1pjLQYK7CsYbbjcUs1_KcjxrjZtf6TetLRwG7K_AAe&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_45&n=3)** | _The Center Square_ Auditor General Tim DeFoor may have bowed to partisan pressure not to accept the Forward Party endorsement, but that hasn't slowed the Pennsylvania Forward Party at all. “We will continue to build a new type of party that asks nothing more of its candidates and affiliates than to lead with ethics and integrity, and to be true public servants, representing the will of as many of their constituents as possible,” Forward Party CEO Lindsey Williams Drath said. Read the article to learn more. **[Candidate Profile: John Curtis for Utah Senate](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/2024/05/31/forward-party-endorses-representative-john-curtis-for-u-s-senate-in-utah/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_45&n=4)** | _Forward Party_ Representative Curtis joined the House of Representatives on November 7th, 2017, via a special election to fill the seat of recently resigned Jason Chaffetz. In his tenure on the Hill, he's earned a reputation as a pragmatic problem solver who's focused on solutions, not politics. He is noted as the 9th most effective Republican member of Congress, an exceptional feat for someone so new to the institution.

With the high stakes, our need for quality, factual journalism has never been more urgent.
**Layoffs. Paywalls. Shrinking budgets. But this year, it’s not happening.
_The Washington Post_ , _CNN_ , and _The Wall Street Journal_ are facing historic business pressures just 5 months from Election Day.
Newsroom layoffs, Artificial intelligence, musical chairs among C-Suite executives, and budget shortfalls are causing more media organizations to hide their best content behind paywalls.
**This is unprecedented.** _Axios_ recently reported that _The Washington Post_ has lost about half of its audience in recent years, and even in the face of a huge election, they’re struggling to add readers.
Their news coverage and business model are failing, and the impact on our democracy has the potential to be catastrophic.
**This is where COURIER comes in. COURIER was founded as a direct response to the decline of accessible, trustworthy journalism in America. **
Across our network of 10 battleground state newsrooms, we fight the spread of bad information about the 2024 elections by delivering factual, local journalism to the online spaces where people actually read and watch their news.
We don’t do clickbait headlines, empty horse race coverage, or play “both sides” just to turn a profit. Instead, we serve news deserts (communities vulnerable to misinformation because they lack trustworthy sources of local news) election news that’s actually relevant in their local community.
**A crazy concept, right? **

Fellow American,

After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long.

THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT!

They said we couldn't win this primary against the odds, but we did it, AND WE DID IT TOGETHER.

_**Thank you.**_
This was possible because of our campaign team, volunteers, and people like you who believed in this “sleeper race.”

I am so proud of what we accomplished last night. Instead of tearing people down, we are building something bigger. **We are building a bigger, better Republican Party together - a party of people who believe in greater freedom and more opportunities.**

This is just the beginning. _We are starting a movement right here in New Jersey._

Before I entered this race, they told me not to run and that it couldn't be done, but I don't believe that's true.

I believe in New Jersey, I believe in its people, and I believe in freedom. And that's why I believe it's time for change.

**[Fellow American, will you join me?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0a6b30f86001495eab7b4eda72c6d94c&_e=HODbtbH4RmPCwe1uytX1FN2-aQWbR95VzJRm7tmH0DCWz6Z2m7PDFcnFQJNjn_h2xBXPy3xMw7VRM1J7JVPaEqOLBmK22Y_deX9N03-84s_N7JCuMCWMPRA9AYm0l0kobIn4koHtNMR-dCFAuPU5q1gvTZ_WtnE4rC1lt5IjwpSQQv9METi42hAPKbE1psmbrbC5D_XXiy5LzRwUXDFoFj1MP_pGrmB1kLZ-2w1q80qn_GFJufusNFhYPj1kmeuVxdyr2QRhna5MxAnAZabFjlwK9SV3ue2wxPckokkwpWmy0hrUwrDtI2Xh5gjiA0-dO0ewzhrpRAjDKFuya2aOVMcpbVSjYFjTEhseH2VwJCQO0EcfmX6MVVAbUfI6nJU4zR2-6DTTIOOjC162IaBQ-cVi-XnDG0NTnBZMxg24AuPr0OcIzsDS8kVGv3OJCURs)**

[** Chip in $100 -> **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0a6b30f86001495eab7b4eda72c6d94c&_e=HODbtbH4RmPCwe1uytX1FN2-aQWbR95VzJRm7tmH0DCWz6Z2m7PDFcnFQJNjn_h2xBXPy3xMw7VRM1J7JVPaEqOLBmK22Y_deX9N03-84s_N7JCuMCWMPRA9AYm0l0kobIn4koHtNMR-dCFAuPU5q1gvTZ_WtnE4rC1lt5IjwpSQQv9METi42hAPKbE1psmbrbC5D_XXiy5LzRwUXDFoFj1MP_pGrmB1kLZ-2w1q80qn_GFJufusNFhYPj1kmeuVxdyr2QRhna5MxAnAZabFjn_7eJxyMMSR6RaCdjE7gWruidItlbpZBx_S_SsCB_2KhQnORCQ4oJjXJUA-WPfaTkg-krW1HJJ2oSaIc1Vx2W98KfeLgLKWTo15yNlOBATp-Hyc1VGQaA9JFp-KaD3frTym712bgZ5vrVEwKASud9M33c3VIksSWEg590OSGfZyzI0EaMpRvwBB5qpLIvP_2A%3D%3D)
I am a political outsider who can deliver results - I've done it before when people told me it couldn't be done. I dedicated the beginning of my career to restoring a New Jersey landmark, Congress Hall, when doubters told me I couldn't.

**They were wrong back then and will be wrong again this November.**

We can't keep sending the same old politicians to Washington and expecting the same unacceptable results. We can continue down the same old road, with the same entrenched DC politicians like Andy Kim and Bob Menendez, or we can go down a different path.

**Oh, and in case you didn't hear, I'm running not against not one but TWO machine Democrats this November.**

We will fight for this Senate seat and take back the Democratic monopoly, **[starting with each and every one of you.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0a6b30f86001495eab7b4eda72c6d94c&_e=HODbtbH4RmPCwe1uytX1FN2-aQWbR95VzJRm7tmH0DCWz6Z2m7PDFcnFQJNjn_h2xBXPy3xMw7VRM1J7JVPaEqOLBmK22Y_deX9N03-84s_N7JCuMCWMPRA9AYm0l0kobIn4koHtNMR-dCFAuPU5q1gvTZ_WtnE4rC1lt5IjwpSQQv9METi42hAPKbE1psmbrbC5D_XXiy5LzRwUXDFoFj1MP_pGrmB1kLZ-2w1q80qn_GFJufusNFhYPj1kmeuVxdyr2QRhna5MxAnAZabFjlwK9SV3ue2wxPckokkwpWlaO0G8nciDC3uJECGoUiX52SEAPepD94PB7Q_4b6tgoUkL53udfpWlt6GHD6q9_kv8OdPSPF8NIISz-VlilpCW8GJqRc8xDSjYzCQjPQ_CHY4ax1nSGU350XYadvXjUf19vu_0gUWhz2e88bTBd7x_)**

It's time to look to November. We must build a movement full of individuals who believe in common-sense solutions to real problems that Americans face. Your contribution today will help catapult our campaign into the official start of the general election.

**[I cannot do it without you, Fellow American.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0a6b30f86001495eab7b4eda72c6d94c&_e=HODbtbH4RmPCwe1uytX1FN2-aQWbR95VzJRm7tmH0DCWz6Z2m7PDFcnFQJNjn_h2xBXPy3xMw7VRM1J7JVPaEqOLBmK22Y_deX9N03-84s_N7JCuMCWMPRA9AYm0l0kobIn4koHtNMR-dCFAuPU5q1gvTZ_WtnE4rC1lt5IjwpSQQv9METi42hAPKbE1psmbrbC5D_XXiy5LzRwUXDFoFj1MP_pGrmB1kLZ-2w1q80qn_GFJufusNFhYPj1kmeuVxdyr2QRhna5MxAnAZabFjlwK9SV3ue2wxPckokkwpWn7YCVMYSb3U_elAnvcO9EcG_RsWiaBh4Btbhg2a5_mc-4XY2h1v7qfdrtK_c9k9pjOw9mbTA-JNN5aM61pZRRVpSDcQU3PS7x0OpFWI2D1RWaKxS-zwpTmwVsqELPm9gPEiN4Jbslx43UEW5nR6uZN)**

Thank you,

Curtis Bashaw
Republican Nominee, United States Senate

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0a6b30f86001495eab7b4eda72c6d94c&_e=HODbtbH4RmPCwe1uytX1FN2-aQWbR95VzJRm7tmH0DCWz6Z2m7PDFcnFQJNjn_h2xBXPy3xMw7VRM1J7JVPaEqOLBmK22Y_deX9N03-84s_N7JCuMCWMPRA9AYm0l0kobIn4koHtNMR-dCFAuPU5q1gvTZ_WtnE4rC1lt5IjwpSQQv9METi42hAPKbE1psmbrbC5D_XXiy5LzRwUXDFoFj1MP_pGrmB1kLZ-2w1q80qn_GFJufusNFhYPj1kmeuVxdyr2QRhna5MxAnAZabFjlwK9SV3ue2wxPckokkwpWnjbJ0Ixsg497ZP-2OaxVELGEXzjyMumQ_CLFi_vFoPwtYZPBE4mRoraEDPMtXKGoZZtrZ94kbNRthydZf-bCEVoTu7YPqZD-Zf3_ik3YqgHw0X-if70-5Z643wFIBvENur45-JeNBxAQHVyrGhDQSm)

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. * When Garcia was asked about how he felt having Trump – now a convicted felon – as the presumptive Republican nominee, he said he wasn’t concerned and that the American people “saw what happened in New York.”

With Trump in town and Garcia continuing to blindly stand with him, all eyes will be on our toss-up race. Republican donors have been more galvanized than ever, and the truth is Garcia is set to see a massive boost in financial support thanks to Trump’s visit.

I am excited to share that today I officially filed my campaign for Governor of New Hampshire surrounded by friends, family, and fellow supporters! Our journey to ensure a prosperous and secure future for the Granite State has begun, and I couldn't be more enthusiastic about what we can achieve together.
I'm running to fight for our families and to ensure the American Dream is alive and well in New Hampshire. With your help, I'm confident that our best days lie ahead. To make this vision a reality, I need your support. Here's how you can help:
1. **Make a Donation :** Your financial support is crucial for us to reach voters across the state and share our message. Every contribution, no matter the size, brings us one step closer to victory. **[Donate Now](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)**

3. **Spread the Word:** Share our message with your friends, family, and social networks. Follow us on social media and help amplify our voice. Every like, share, and conversation makes a difference.

Together, we can build on our Republican successes and create a brighter future for all Granite Staters. I'm committed to delivering results, just as I have as Senate President, and I'm ready to do it as your Governor.
Thank you for your continued support and dedication.
In Liberty, Chuck Morse

He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

body:
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1261%2E62735%2EjMp2wH)
| | | Dear Peter I hope this message finds you well. As we gear up for the crucial battle ahead to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate,**I'm reaching out to share some disappointing news regarding the state of our democratic process.** You may have heard about the recent cancellation of the bipartisan U.S. Senate debate that was scheduled for May 30th, during the Mackinac Policy Conference. **This cancellation was not due to lack of interest from the candidates, but rather the refusal of Elissa Slotkin to participate at the last minute.** I am deeply concerned over this refusal. The Detroit Regional Chamber, the organizing body, rightly points out that **this last minute cancellation undermines our democratic principles and deprives Michigan citizens of the opportunity to hear directly from those vying for their trust. ** This refusal to engage in open discourse deprives voters of the chance to evaluate candidates side by side, to scrutinize their platforms, and to make informed decisions. **It's a missed opportunity to uphold the tradition of civic engagement and public discourse that has been a cornerstone of our democracy.** As we move forward in this campaign, I remain committed to transparency, accountability, and the values that represent the best interests of Michigan families and communities.**I believe that every voter deserves the chance to hear directly from their candidates, to ask tough questions, and to demand answers.** [**That's why I'm asking for your support today. Together, we can stand up against the trend of political evasion and ensure that the voices of Michigan citizens are heard loud and clear.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1603?t=2&akid=1261%2E62735%2EjMp2wH) Your contribution will help us amplify our message, reach more voters, and fight for a better future for all.

Greetings!
Joe Biden and his enablers in Congress have abused federal power and used lawfare to force anti-American DEI programs and gender ideology in our local schools.
That's why we are keeping tabs on key primary elections as we engage in the most important races to protect the American family and the rights of parents.
Here is what you need to know from yesterday's primaries:
South Dakota State Senate Pro-family Greg Blanc wins after campaigning to protect children online! [APP PAC ran the below ad attacking S.D. State Senator Michael Walsh](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KEdzMa9Ig254vOULGH1Bs1BU2U9LXYVeBIyYkKy_BVoP4pjqUDwTIP1qP4gjul751bykum-7h37Mo3UhiW6_u0TOZTofY7Los6l7Kz9jxkmdzR9RncciHZ4dPns8LLPINTChvaxvSxV5J47AAI1ZBIfy6eg--GTj-w3Uk03xIvAa4yMcTbIlAQ==&c=23_-raY_P-5GRIq6-LON870FFmewQI_jBugUBSJXSU1wyw1-Rj2b0w==&ch=XNg4KYyub1Rt61MjAV1pkODzDMHzMFgZR9bCewD2vbwkqpUU_jS2sg==) for voting to kill an age verification bill in committee that would have protected kids online. Walsh won't stand in our way next year -- we helped send him home. This is a huge deal -- it's the first time we've spent money to take out an elected official for not supporting age-verification, and it won't be the last!
You can view the ad here:
---
[](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KEdzMa9Ig254vOULGH1Bs1BU2U9LXYVeBIyYkKy_BVoP4pjqUDwTIP1qP4gjul751bykum-7h37Mo3UhiW6_u0TOZTofY7Los6l7Kz9jxkmdzR9RncciHZ4dPns8LLPINTChvaxvSxV5J47AAI1ZBIfy6eg--GTj-w3Uk03xIvAa4yMcTbIlAQ==&c=23_-raY_P-5GRIq6-LON870FFmewQI_jBugUBSJXSU1wyw1-Rj2b0w==&ch=XNg4KYyub1Rt61MjAV1pkODzDMHzMFgZR9bCewD2vbwkqpUU_jS2sg==)

Montana Senate Pro-family Tim Sheehy will face Sen. Jon Tester in a massively important race.
Control of the Senate could come down to this race. Democrat Senator Jon Tester blocked efforts to defund DEI and the transgender agenda in our schools and is a key enabler of Biden's attacks on the family. Pro-family Tim Sheehy easily won his primary and will make this extremely competitive.
Montana Governor Pro-family Gov. Greg Gianforte proves that family issues win elections.
Montana Governor Greg Gianforte boldly confronted the transgender industry -- signing bills that protect girls' sports and keep doctors from performing experimental sex changes on young kids, and passing a massive, pro-family agenda. His record allowed him to cruise to victory in the GOP primary, and he is now heavily favored to win in November.
Iowa Congressional Rep. Zach Nunn wins unopposed for Iowa's 3rd district!
Zach Nunn currently serves as one of Iowa's congressmen and has been a strong champion for American families. Our team will work closely with Congressman Nunn and continue pushing for pro-family legislation to be passed and signed into law by President Trump!
We'll continue updating you as the election season rolls on. More to come soon.
Thank you,
Terry Schilling President American Principles Project

Fellow American,

After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long.

THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT!

They said we couldn't win this primary against the odds, but we did it, AND WE DID IT TOGETHER.

_**Thank you.**_
This was possible because of our campaign team, volunteers, and people like you who believed in this “sleeper race.”

I am so proud of what we accomplished last night. Instead of tearing people down, we are building something bigger. **We are building a bigger, better Republican Party together - a party of people who believe in greater freedom and more opportunities.**

This is just the beginning. _We are starting a movement right here in New Jersey._

Before I entered this race, they told me not to run and that it couldn't be done, but I don't believe that's true.

I believe in New Jersey, I believe in its people, and I believe in freedom. And that's why I believe it's time for change.

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Peter,

Earlier this year, I began my 800 mile advocacy run across Mississippi to raise awareness about our campaign’s commitment to fighting for reproductive rights, access to affordable and quality healthcare, and an economy that works for all of us.

Today, I completed my 200th mile of that journey.

This was particularly special because this leg of my run ended in my hometown of Rolling Fork. Seeing so many folks waiting for me cheering me on and waving signs in support was truly heartwarming.

Growing up in this community, I learned the value of lending a helping hand to your neighbors. We didn’t have much, but we always had each other.

It’s a lesson I’ve carried with me my entire life. Through serving in our Armed Forces, working in The White House, and advocating for working people and mothers as an attorney, I’ve remained steadfast in my commitment to work for others and create better, stronger communities where each of us has the ability to thrive.

That’s exactly why I’m running for the U.S. Senate. Our leaders in Washington have forgotten their obligation to serve the people who elected them. Partisan politics have left more folks feeling disillusioned with our democracy than ever before. It doesn’t have to be this way.

Our team has thousands of supporters from Mississippi and across the country working alongside us because they’re ready for change. As your next Senator, I will always put people before politics and work with my colleagues regardless of their party for the best interests of our communities.

Having a large team is crucial – our opponent has money, but we have the people who make this campaign possible every day. name: David Hogg
subject: Updates from the campaign trail ✈️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend –
I’ve been on the road helping our candidates so often lately that it’s rare I get to sleep in my own bed anymore. But each time I get the news that someone we endorsed won their election, I know it’s worth it.
Here’s a few of the places I’ve been lately:
*
Orlando,
FL
to
support
Nate
Douglas
.
At
23
years
old,
Nate
would
be
the
youngest
person
in
the
Florida
legislature.
*
Atlanta,
GA
to
support
Bryce
Berry
.
He’s
22
years
old
and
would
be
the
first
public
school
teacher
ever
elected
to
the
state
legislature.
*
Houston,
TX
to
support
Molly
Cook
.
She’s
also
23
years
old
and
is
currently
the
youngest
and
most
progressive
member
of
the
Texas
Senate.
This work is tiring, but it’s worth it to elect so many awesome young leaders — and none of it is possible without your support. Can you pitch in $15 today to help us and Serve America keep electing young leaders across the country? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
One thing I’ve learned is that not everyone does it like us. A lot of big national organizations will parachute in, shell out thousands of dollars for really generic-seeming ads, and call it a day.
But being on the ground, meeting campaign staff, and talking directly to voters allows us to invest your donations much more effectively because we know exactly the best place to spend it.
We can identify what each campaign needs to move the needle in their races — whether that’s more doors knocked, a TV ad, a mail piece on a certain issue, or something else entirely.
And the work is paying off, too. Last year we elected our first endorsed candidate, Nadarius Clark, in Virginia. Just a couple weeks ago, Molly Cook won a special election to serve out the remainder of the current term in the Texas Senate — AND she just won the Democratic primary runoff by only 74 votes!
We’re looking forward to electing Nate, Bryce, Molly, and all of our endorsed candidates this November, but we truly cannot do it without your support.
As a grassroots organization, we don’t take corporate donations. We’re counting on your help to support each of the candidates we endorse.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXR7ikeJBNO6mfChJbntSf5x5BFtoLLEDDCoosSMRWp00OcKc_6L7TcoTZI0DG9DONj1O_T91soy6ZZkH2u8-Mh3aLP-fKn4NLVDdVa2Q1U6JgG00iaDzrKVUsU07RW5FqB3352sPBiThz_eodQzqohEguoOhYaoxFY-O1jfcdwhPg%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXQed23wQDyXlmu6cYgsSyk9D5hUidQCj9SZ-6NvTvuigUo-v_DMT-7Z4_u86Dx8xi5ac3d0KPU62IB_fInbkWUucJ2ClxRCM9s6mvRXSy9yw6qeOLuK2OcdfRKMLzRleAbhisGPio83UZwKZ1BVIL3hXWQ-KAjO1MRpU-V2yNzZPQ%3D%3D).**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the [Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXS_gLMQaFoKtQQER22lw-yqKV0mLwE9hHUB4WHVE0RqTdjgPytmDTYTa4VA3Hlag7yjke-hqZr6WSWVYbGP3V1Fxcj0ZtlJtdct3YKV67g3HZI41RNFgXqrV_H55Nqxj-fiLrVPTj8emR1IfcCSl5R4f3PQMV7fYSlo-5JlSGSHRA%3D%3D).**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXQP9xMwvvgaQrzE8I0NC8UkNRnypSZ_O529vqL83p4dqFxdEc3yZlmLOf0izLjUh19vMdPd5Jbexngm_bYa8AQRKaquMuoHKyarVuaz4m5L5_2WHtwPXFVrQ5RrkL0UeP_mS8QSe67P5s6EPxwj6v8txFkvq5huQkCIYHOZTp5v9Q%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our [**National Survey on the Department of Justice**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXRmXlhFx0j64bN3YIUJNXsvL5ZVz3ISxeogB5oW4P7by-yMkw8lyqXRSIjJFGsQWtpvsiImkXGRLHhp_RB6j8_MCprZgLf7M1wxdtCcvZ82lM8WlU5aRBsOzb3Sd92mRdJPWQq8FYNFOKbxG1s7ys5-gvCJOOEZTDeBLuhdNbqsKQ%3D%3D) and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=24024de9e9ac424ba8abc8e8ef77502f&_e=p2KYbceQgRtC1lOlXcko-fkkivNpfAd0BOtJqi5RECHlfwzYHtpiVr4eLP6BBjWaM1B6tAJ6AKuZJEIi_gYYHZnFbkFQmwZ9oDe5oH9zkkLZ2g81TKV-EVyViTCk0npgquyadZiU-2X8O862-hPhXmpAUuYgdXFHmktpWSN2cGvUDwuN6Q3E6_Z5XoZKopjGm7OSXvKyLGWVxaj0wCjRNa16uW62hIAARqBHuo9VVXSVq1ilw90wiC3SiuEc4ngCoqrjQBf--_FzIcWoWQQSPNOlW2uCFD_omqqkhIO7m-_sWKBMrll2QT96sM2Wi75siISsODr3iC4DRsqoAeWFmyAnkfsy-8xVbK5kw52pDNzeMEoeUi49fCUwPH0hJMnKh-5j4wU_j71OxpWcezBTQQ%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter,
Throughout my career, I’ve been proudly dedicated to leadership and service, holding senior positions at organizations like the Make-A-Wish Foundation and the American Red Cross.
