| Peter,
I'm proud to be from Maine and I'm proud to be a Marine. I graduated from Gardiner Area High School and shortly after enlisted in the United States Marine Corps. As a Marine I learned that duty and honor are what makes a man. I learned that being part of something bigger than yourself is what service is all about. I learned that facing adversity with toughness, integrity and hard work is how you get through life. It was also the only way to get through Marine Recruit Depot Parris Island, and I loved it.
Experience matters. Facing adversity and coming out stronger on the other side matters. I'm running for Congress because I know that my service in the Marine Corps and life experience will allow me to not be pushed around in DC so that I can make the best decisions for my constituents back home.
Tomorrow is the last day to vote early in your town. The Republican Primary is on Tuesday, June 11th. I don't know how this primary will turn out, but I do know that your vote can make the difference.
I promise you I will always be faithful to my oath to the Constitution.
Semper Fi.
-Mike

name: Jill Stein
subject: The fight for LGBTQIA equality continues
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=1)
---
Peter,

The last few years there has been a dark cloud hanging over Pride Month as we’ve seen an alarming escalation of legislative attacks against hard-won 2SLGBTQIA+ rights.

The full scope of this assault is difficult to measure. The ACLU is currently tracking 515 pieces of anti-LGBTQ legislation across the country, yet Trans Legislation Tracker has clocked nearly 600 bills attacking the trans community alone.

The vast majority of these bills fail, but that isn’t the point. The constant drumbeat of anti-LGBTQ rhetoric is fueling a toxic environment that openly encourages physical violence and social isolation of our friends, neighbors, and loved ones.

As a result we’ve seen increasing rates of self harm and suicidal ideation, particularly among young people. According to the Trevor Project, as many as 70% of LGBTQ+ teens reported symptoms of anxiety within the past year, and 57% symptoms of depression.

They are aching for mental health support but the majority of them can’t get it – whether it’s too expensive or their state has literally banned the gender affirming care they need.

This is a national public health crisis, and as your president, I would treat it accordingly.

My administration will leverage the full powers of the executive branch to guarantee the human rights of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

I will pressure Congress to pass the Equality Act, the PRIDE Act, the Every Child Deserves a Family Act, and other bills to instill ironclad protections for LGBTQ+ rights at the federal level – effectively ending the vast majority of the attacks from these radical, right-wing lawmakers and their weak liberal enablers.

We will support legislation that expands healthcare access for vulnerable populations and continue the push for universal healthcare – which is a top priority for my administration.

We will develop and implement a broad scale public education program to counter the extremist, right-wing rhetoric fueling many of these bills, and direct the Department of Education to develop curriculum and support school programs to protect LGBTQ kids.

We will declare trans murder and suicide rates a national public health emergency – which they are – and instruct the DOJ to track and investigate hate crimes against the LGBTQ community at the federal level. This will help us better identify trends and spot early warning signs of new attacks BEFORE they can escalate to the levels we currently see.

These are just a few of the solutions our administration will pursue. [**You can read my full platform on LGBTQIA+ rights here**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=2) (you’ll find it under “People”).

**Ours is the only campaign that will be on the ballot across the country this November that is fighting for people, planet, and peace – and the only credible challenge to empire, genocide, and hate.

[I need your support to guarantee that every American has the chance to vote for this vision. Will you contribute today](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=4)
---
Remember: the first Pride was a riot. Patrons of the now legendary Stonewall Inn stood up to continuous harassment and police brutality targeting New York's thriving LGBTQ community.

From the beginning, Pride Month has been about challenging structural hate and dismantling systems that exclude, silence, and sideline people because of who they are and who they love.

It is long past time the LGBTQIA+ community had a true ally in the White House.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2slbtqia&n=5)
---
We will end the acceptance of a violent culture that devalues the humanity of our LGBTQIA+ siblings. We will fight for the liberation of LGBTQIA+ people around the world.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

subject: Dave Williams wants to burn all Pride flags
body:
Colorado State GOP, with Dave Williams as its chair, has released multiple statements since the start of Pride month attacking the LGBTQ+ community. | | | | | [](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=9b2b9f57af&e=3818d77efc)
---
| Pride flags symbolize love, diversity, and the fight for equal rights.
[The Colorado State GOP is actively calling for the burning of pride flags and attacking the LGBTQ+ community.](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=db8adad5a4&e=3818d77efc) Dave Williams, the state GOP chair, has sanctioned this divisive rhetoric that perpetuates a dangerous environment of hatred and intolerance towards the LGBTQ+ community.
Encouraging their destruction is a direct attack on the principles of freedom and equality that this nation stands for. These hostile words led to the kind of violence that took five lives at the Club Q shooting and countless others across the country. People like Dave Williams can only bring hate and division to our community.
As a proud member of the LGBTQ+ community, I stand with friends, family, and everyone who they seek to harm. It is time for El Paso County and our nation to come together against hate and violence.
Stand with me for a brighter future for our LGBTQ+ community and all people.
River Gassen

| | Dear , You may ask, “Why would you want a holster that fits under your arm?” Because when out and about, concealed carry is the most **[responsible form of self defense.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/17942/6374453/cc42d7bea25a71057743b1ecb418a299fc0973e3/ec865757c329b9162d0038f276a42ebdabb37d48)** I am not one for brandishing any weapon. In fact, my goal is to have it remain so discreet, no one will EVER know I am carrying. That’s TRUE self-defense. You know it’s there... But you never have to use it. **[So I keep mine close by, tucked away.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/17942/6374453/cc42d7bea25a71057743b1ecb418a299fc0973e3/ec865757c329b9162d0038f276a42ebdabb37d48)**[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/17942/6374453/a99dedef68663e48fdbcdd7d628f5770f3043074/ec865757c329b9162d0038f276a42ebdabb37d48)[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/17942/6374453/a99dedef68663e48fdbcdd7d628f5770f3043074/ec865757c329b9162d0038f276a42ebdabb37d48)

It’s easy to retrieve when I put it in my safe at night. And it’s secure, so it will stay exactly where I want it. You might be thinking about getting one, And in my humble opinion, **[**You DEFINITELY should!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/17942/6374453/cc42d7bea25a71057743b1ecb418a299fc0973e3/ec865757c329b9162d0038f276a42ebdabb37d48)** ~John, _GunnerGear.com_

body:
Your support will go three times as far for a limited time.

---
| | |
* * *
---
| | | | Dear Peter,
---
| | Peter — today, we’re kicking off our Summer Membership Drive — and this is an important one. How many members pitch in will determine how big our campaigns can go _for the rest of this year_. **A group of donors has agreed to triple match every membership contribution this month.**
---

| | Here are three reasons your LCV membership matters SO much right now:
---
| |
1. **Big Oil’s shills in Congress are gearing up to try to block limits on tailpipe emissions from vehicles,** which are the number one source of greenhouse gas emissions in the United States. [**_We are campaigning to stop the MAGA movement from sabotaging clean, zero-emission cars and trucks. You can help by renewing your LCV membership for just $5 to power our hard-hitting environmental campaigns >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/dmyWFAykjDJ_)

[**_We are working around the clock to fight gas executives who are putting profits ahead of communities of color and low-income communities where they dump pollution, and we need your help to keep going. Please, renew your LCV membership for just $5 right now >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/VXb6s8qW9_)

3. **Pro-polluter lawmakers are threatening to eliminate limits on toxic air pollution from power plants.** Overturning these safeguards would be disastrous for the health of our communities, our children, and our planet. [**_Don’t wait — renew your LCV membership today for just $5 to power our response >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/WabwQx2~)

---
| | So much rides on your membership — here’s where our Summer Membership Drive stands right now:

Peter,
**“Let me call you back... I’m repealing the abortion ban.”**
That’s the text that Oscar De Los Santos sent me a few weeks ago when I called him to let him know that Leaders We Deserve was going to endorse his campaign.
Oscar is a former public school teacher, a Rhodes Scholar, and one of the most progressive members of the Arizona House of Representatives.
**He fought like hell to repeal Arizona’s 1864 abortion ban — and won. Now, the MAGA Republicans who control the Arizona House are throwing a fit and just kicked Oscar off of his committees. It’s time to fight back.**
[**Can you make a $5 contribution now to support Oscar De Los Santos and the work we are all doing to elect the new generation of progressive leaders?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240605-1?refcode=em20240605-1&amount=5&refcode2=772_587540_fMGmrr&akid=772%2E587540%2EfMGmrr)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240605-1?refcode=em20240605-1&amount=5&refcode2=772_587540_fMGmrr&akid=772%2E587540%2EfMGmrr)
Let me tell you a little bit more about Oscar, Peter:
He’s the son of working-class immigrants, a former 6th grade teacher, and a long-time voting rights organizer.
Oscar was first elected to the Arizona House in 2022. And since then, he’s been working around the clock to deliver for young people, women, the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, and the working class.
He introduced the Arizona Medical Debt Cancellation Act, which Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs enacted via executive order. **It’s the largest medical debt cancellation program in U.S. history and will wipe out $2 billion of medical debt for 1 million Arizonans.**
He’s the lead author of the Statewide Anti-discrimination Act, which would ban discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in the Grand Canyon State.
And he’s also introduced legislation to end the use of private prisons in Arizona, increase the minimum wage, strengthen labor unions, and crack down on shady private equity firms and mega corporations that are jacking up the cost of housing.
**That’s why Leaders We Deserve is 100% behind Oscar. We’re going all out to make sure he wins reelection — but we can’t do it without you.**

It’s the largest medical debt cancellation program in U.S. history and will wipe out $2 billion of medical debt for 1 million Arizonans. He’s the lead author of the Statewide Anti-discrimination Act, which would ban discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in the Grand Canyon State. And he’s also introduced legislation to end the use of private prisons in Arizona, increase the minimum wage, strengthen labor unions, and crack down on shady private equity firms and mega corporations that are jacking up the cost of housing. That’s why Leaders We Deserve is 100% behind Oscar. We’re going all out to make sure he wins reelection — but we can’t do it without you. Thank you, David Hogg

body:
While I’ve been out and proud for decades, I remember clearly what it was like to be a gay kid.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86339075/477570632/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgwMTk5Yy03MDIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=egU5jluj_aZcCahub73mTHveoziuVrQ5Ra4L2P6vBtI=&emci=df3d2c36-6923-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2380199c-7023-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=43402272) | Happy Pride Month, Peter! 🏳️🌈 For as long as I can remember, there’s always been a special electricity in the air in June. While I’ve been out and proud for decades, I remember clearly what it was like to be a gay kid, afraid to be myself, and without the support of my community. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86339076/477570633/-1822710727?refcode=E8857-20240605-PrideMonth-Image-LGBTQRights&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgwMTk5Yy03MDIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=egU5jluj_aZcCahub73mTHveoziuVrQ5Ra4L2P6vBtI=) It’s remarkable to consider how much things have changed for LGBTQ+ Americans over the course of my lifetime. My teenage self would be amazed to learn that I would one day be legally married to my wife, Elizabeth, a mom to two teens myself, and the first openly LGBTQ+ person elected to represent Vermont in Congress. However — despite the progress we’ve made in my lifetime alone, our fight for equality is far from over. Last year, a record number of anti-LGBTQ+ bills were introduced in state legislatures across the country. _That record has already been broken this year._ These coordinated and cruel attacks have been particularly targeted at the freedom and dignity of transgender children, their ability to access gender-affirming care, participate in school sports, and be accepted into their communities. **I knew I was gay at 11 years old – and it was sometimes very lonely and scary.** I know how it feels to have your very existence questioned. I know anyone who has ever felt on _“the outside”_ can understand not belonging and feeling vulnerable. You don’t have to be gay or trans to know that we need to stand up for our kids. **We can and we must – loudly and proudly – defend transgender youth who are being used as a rallying cry for hatred and bigotry by partisan extremists. LGBTQ+ children are counting on adults like you and me to stand up and fight for them.** This Pride Month, I pledge to remember the struggles and bravery of our queer ancestors — trailblazers like Leslie Feinberg, Marsha P. Johnson, and Harvey Milk — and do everything in my power to honor their activism through continued action to protect the progress we’ve won in the fight for LGBTQ+ liberation, particularly for our transgender community. Happy Pride Month, Peter. — Becca Becca Balint made history as the first woman and openly LGBTQ+ person to represent Vermont in Congress. A Member of the Equality Caucus, Becca has become a leading voice against anti-LGBTQ+ legislation in Washington and an outspoken advocate for transgender children.

[_**This Pride Month, can you make a contribution to her campaign to make sure we have the resources needed to keep her fighting for us in Congress?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86339077/477570634/-1822710727?refcode=E8857-20240605-PrideMonth-SL-LGBTQRights&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgwMTk5Yy03MDIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=egU5jluj_aZcCahub73mTHveoziuVrQ5Ra4L2P6vBtI=)

clean_body: While I’ve been out and proud for decades, I remember clearly what it was like to be a gay kid. | | Happy Pride Month, Peter! 🏳️🌈 For as long as I can remember, there’s always been a special electricity in the air in June. While I’ve been out and proud for decades, I remember clearly what it was like to be a gay kid, afraid to be myself, and without the support of my community. = It’s remarkable to consider how much things have changed for LGBTQ+ Americans over the course of my lifetime. My teenage self would be amazed to learn that I would one day be legally married to my wife, Elizabeth, a mom to two teens myself, and the first openly LGBTQ+ person elected to represent Vermont in Congress. However — despite the progress we’ve made in my lifetime alone, our fight for equality is far from over. Last year, a record number of anti-LGBTQ+ bills were introduced in state legislatures across the country. That record has already been broken this year. These coordinated and cruel attacks have been particularly targeted at the freedom and dignity of transgender children, their ability to access gender-affirming care, participate in school sports, and be accepted into their communities. I knew I was gay at 11 years old – and it was sometimes very lonely and scary. I know how it feels to have your very existence questioned. I know anyone who has ever felt on “the outside” can understand not belonging and feeling vulnerable. You don’t have to be gay or trans to know that we need to stand up for our kids. We can and we must – loudly and proudly – defend transgender youth who are being used as a rallying cry for hatred and bigotry by partisan extremists. LGBTQ+ children are counting on adults like you and me to stand up and fight for them. This Pride Month, I pledge to remember the struggles and bravery of our queer ancestors — trailblazers like Leslie Feinberg, Marsha P. Johnson, and Harvey Milk — and do everything in my power to honor their activism through continued action to protect the progress we’ve won in the fight for LGBTQ+ liberation, particularly for our transgender community. Happy Pride Month, Peter. — Becca Becca Balint made history as the first woman and openly LGBTQ+ person to represent Vermont in Congress. # [#]
Friend, I know your inbox has been busy.

Don’t worry, I just want to say two words: thank you.

Meeting our fundraising goal for last month was a major stepping stone in our fight to defend CA-25, and I’m proud to report that not only did we do that — we exceeded it.

What we’ve built here is exactly what encouraged me to get into politics: community. One around shared values and a shared belief that together, we can move our district, state, and country in the direction of progress.

Now that I’m running against a MAGA Republican who intends to do the exact opposite to California’s 25th, showing our strength as a movement is more important than ever — and I’m incredibly grateful to have you stand with me.

We've got 5 months to Election Day. Let’s get to work!

Sincerely,
Raul

In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. name: Sal McBride (Sarah's Mom)
subject: Can you support my daughter’s campaign for Congress?
body:
My husband and I couldn't be more proud.
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240605-1?refcode=em20240605-1&amount=5&refcode2=566_21716_9gVIOy&akid=566%2E21716%2E9gVIOy)
Hey, Sal McBride here! 👋 For those who haven’t met me, I’m Sarah’s mom (and #1 fan).
**My husband, Dave, and I are so proud that our daughter Sarah is running to represent us in Congress — and with less than 100 days until her primary election, I’m writing to ask you to support her campaign today.**
If you’ve ever had the good fortune to meet Sarah, then you know how big her smile gets when you bring up Delaware.
Ever since she was little, she’s loved this state with her entire being. When most kids were playing sports, she was spending her nights and weekends knocking on neighbor’s doors to get out the vote for Jack Markell and Beau Biden.
**She even came up with a term for folks who are patriotic about their state — “statriots.” 😂**
She’s the only person I know who had been to every town and city in Delaware by the age of 18. And when she went to college, spent time in the White House, and served as the national spokesperson for the Human Rights Campaign, **we always knew Delaware remained at the center of her heart.**
Now, we’ve watched Sarah grow from a young “statriot” to a respected leader in the State Senate who has led the way on paid family leave, common-sense gun reform, and access to healthcare for all Delawareans, regardless of their background or where they live.
**I may be biased, but I don’t know anyone who will work harder or more passionately for our state than Sarah.**
[**So with less than 100 days to go until her primary election, I have to ask: Can you make a donation right now to my daughter's congressional campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240605-1?refcode=em20240605-1&amount=5&refcode2=566_21716_9gVIOy&akid=566%2E21716%2E9gVIOy)

In thanks,
Sal McBride

Peter,

After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long.

clean_body: THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT! | Peter, After last night, all eyes are on our campaign. All eyes are on our race to take back our state from the Democrat monopoly that has dominated NJ politics for too long. THEY SAID IT COULDN'T BE DONE, BUT WE DID IT! They said we couldn't win this primary against the odds, but we did it, AND WE DID IT TOGETHER. Thank you. This was possible because of our campaign team, volunteers, and people like you who believed in this “sleeper race.” I am so proud of what we accomplished last night. Instead of tearing people down, we are building something bigger. We are building a bigger, better Republican Party together - a party of people who believe in greater freedom and more opportunities. This is just the beginning. We are starting a movement right here in New Jersey. Before I entered this race, they told me not to run and that it couldn't be done, but I don't believe that's true. I believe in New Jersey, I believe in its people, and I believe in freedom. And that's why I believe it's time for change. I am a political outsider who can deliver results - I've done it before when people told me it couldn't be done. I dedicated the beginning of my career to restoring a New Jersey landmark, Congress Hall, when doubters told me I couldn't. They were wrong back then and will be wrong again this November. We can't keep sending the same old politicians to Washington and expecting the same unacceptable results. We can continue down the same old road, with the same entrenched DC politicians like Andy Kim and Bob Menendez, or we can go down a different path. Oh, and in case you didn't hear, I'm running not against not one but TWO machine Democrats this November. We will fight for this Senate seat and take back the Democratic monopoly, It's time to look to November. We must build a movement full of individuals who believe in common-sense solutions to real problems that Americans face. Your contribution today will help catapult our campaign into the official start of the general election. Thank you, Curtis Bashaw Republican Nominee, United States Senate | GET TO KNOW CURTIS Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans. A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. clean_body: How well do you remember Trump's first term in office? | | Let's pause for a second -- take a break from the Trump verdict and his fundraising numbers to talk about another issue. Climate change. Specifically, what would a Trump victory mean for the fight to protect our planet from a changing climate. How well do you remember Trump's first term in office? Do you remember when he withdrew the U.S. from the Paris Agreement on climate change? Do you remember the judges he appointed who repeatedly undermined our ability to fight against climate change? Do you remember the pipeline projects and rolling back environmental rules? Now know this: if he gets another chance in office, it'll be a lot worse. Don't take our word for it either, take his: Last month, at a fundraiser at Mar-a-Lago (of course) Donald Trump told oil executives that if they would raise him $1 billion dollars -- that’s a billion with a b -- he would be willing to dismantle all of the progress the Biden administration has made on climate change. He actually told them they were getting off cheap for $1 billion, that it would be an absolute steal for them when they consider how much money they'd make and save if he got another term in office. This is one of the very, very serious issues at stake in this election. | | | | | Governor Glenn Youngkin here.

Today, Virginia chose freedom over mandates from California. I am proud to announce that we have just ended the electric vehicle mandate imposed on Virginians from California bureaucrats thousands of miles away.

When far-left progressives had total control over our Commonwealth, they passed a misguided bill that made Virginians subject to a policy dictated from Gavin Newsom - a policy that would have forced Virginians to buy electric vehicles and punish Virginia auto dealers for selling gas-powered cars.

Look, if you want to buy an electric vehicle, that's your decision. But Virginians must have the freedom to make that decision on their own, not because Gavin Newsom tells you to.

That's why I tried to repeal this nonsensical mandate through the legislature when I first took office, which the Republican-controlled House of Delegates passed and the Democrat-controlled Senate blocked. That's why I tried to repeal it again this year, which the Democrat-controlled legislature blocked once again despite overwhelming support from Virginians.

But I'm not going to let the far-left progressives stop us from protecting the freedom of Virginians. When you hired me three years ago, you gave me the power to take action necessary to stand up for you. That is exactly what I've done.

By ending this mandate, you now have the freedom to drive the car that is best for you and your family instead of being dictated to by California.

In order for Virginia to be the best place to live, work and raise a family, we must defend our independence. Please help me reject illogical mandates and secure our freedoms by donating below.

| | Friend, Last week Donald Trump was convicted of 34 different felonies. The jury found him guilty of fabricating almost _three dozen_ records in an attempt to cover up payments to adult film star Stormy Daniels with whom he had a sexual encounter. And even though he was found guilty by a unanimous jury, he is still calling the charges politically motivated and attacked people involved in the case, from the judge to the Manhattan District Attorney. Trump’s continued attempts to discredit the investigation and the people involved are just another example of a corrupt politician trying to politicize our justice system. Our judicial system is supposed to be free from political interference, but time and again Trump has politicized the judiciary. [**From packing the Supreme Court with MAGA Justices who overturned**** _Roe v. Wade_****, to claiming that his 34 felony convictions are just another witch hunt, Trump politicized our justice system in nefarious ways. Our courts are supposed to be unbiased, and they’re anything but that right now. We’re fighting to get politics out of our courts, but we need you on our side. So please, chip in $10 now and help us get partisan influence out of our judicial system.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86344581/477583991/-1153425267?refcode=6-5-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ5ODJhNWZmLTc4MjMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=29mNz3NUciHx0w5TLTK6QcYUGRUhATadcT3MMYmiNVg=) We’ve seen what happens when conservative interests and Republican politicians influence our courts: attacks on fundamental rights and freedoms and handouts to special interests and megadonors at the expense of the wellbeing of the American people. **[Our judicial system worked properly this time when Donald Trump was convicted of 34 felonies, but the corruption we’re seeing in courts across the country is sickening. Nationwide, conservative megadonors and politicians are trying to stick their hands in our justice system and alter outcomes to fit their agenda. It’s not right and we’re trying to stop it. If you’re ready for a fair and unbiased judiciary, please contribute $10 or whatever you can today to join us in the fight.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86344583/477583993/-1153425267?refcode=6-5-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ5ODJhNWZmLTc4MjMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=29mNz3NUciHx0w5TLTK6QcYUGRUhATadcT3MMYmiNVg=)** Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86344797/477584677/1746775449?ms=mw_em_240605_1&refcode=mw_em_240605_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTJlY2JhYi03OTIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K290v5aY6UDSqBXZe7Y4K9TuDCkh2PFtRg1MJW4boHA=) Derek,

Just days before the Supreme Court is set to hear cases about the 2020 election and the January 6th insurrection, here's where things stand with Justice Samuel Alito. You’ve probably seen the news that Alito flew an upside-down American flag – a symbol adopted by Trump supporters who falsely claimed the 2020 election was stolen – at his home while the Court was considering an election case in 2021.

This comes on the heels of the never ending cycle of ethical violations at the Court, with our justices refusing to disclose their entanglements with political donors with business before the Court.

**_[If you’re tired of seeing Supreme Court justices never be held accountable for their unethical behavior, sign my petition to call on Congress to pass my _Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal and Transparency (SCERT) Act_ >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86344798/477584678/1448752379?ms=mw_em_240605_1&refcode=mw_em_240605_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTJlY2JhYi03OTIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K290v5aY6UDSqBXZe7Y4K9TuDCkh2PFtRg1MJW4boHA=&emci=fc714ce4-e021-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=952ecbab-7923-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4568237)_**

I don’t know about you, but I was raised to treat the flag with respect, not as a symbol of politics. _And especially not as a sign of support for overthrowing our democracy._

Sure, everyone has a First Amendment right to expression, but judges are expected to meet a higher standard. Justice Alito should recuse himself from court cases relating to January 6th. My bill would require justices to disclose when they have a connection to an amicus before the Court (which clearly Alito does) and require them to explain their recusal decisions to the public.

But here we are, a justice showing bias on a matter before the Court and refusing to recuse. No wonder public trust in the Court is plummeting.

_**_[Add your name to my petition now to stand with me in the fight for ethics reform at SCOTUS.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86344799/477584679/1448752379?ms=mw_em_240605_1&refcode=mw_em_240605_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTJlY2JhYi03OTIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K290v5aY6UDSqBXZe7Y4K9TuDCkh2PFtRg1MJW4boHA=&emci=fc714ce4-e021-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=952ecbab-7923-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4568237)_**_

Thank you for making your voice heard,

Mark Warner

Team, June is Gun Violence Awareness Month. Too many families across Florida and in our district have felt the scourge of gun violence. This includes 14 innocent students and 3 staff our community lost in 2018 at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School. I'm also thinking of the shooting that occurred at Pulse Nightclub in 2016, which took the lives of 49 people, many who were targeted because of identifying as LGBTQ+. So much tragedy and pain. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86344900/477585176/1568943115?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85Njc2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NGU1ZjM2MS03YTIzLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gqDtIQZ92ms0PYKe1VAe0eYQ7fxZMXdjOEIHNec8lAo=&emci=fa26983f-9822-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=44e5f361-7a23-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6576167)
_Paying respect at a memorial for the loved ones lost in the Pulse Nightclub shooting._ As a public official, **I see it as my responsibility to help prevent future instances of gun violence from occurring.** The only surefire way we can do this is through legislation – it's why I led the charge to pass a bipartisan gun violence prevention bill in the state legislature in response to the MSD shooting. Now, as a Congressman, I’m working to pass legislation that would expand background checks, enforce red flag laws nationwide, and ban assault weapons — work like this has earned us the endorsement of Brady PAC, too. I hope that throughout the month of June, you join me on this mission to make gun violence a thing of the past in our country. Too many families who deserve to hold their loved ones close cannot today as a result of these senseless acts. Thoughts and prayers will not fix the problem in front of us. Only action can do that. [**That's why I'm asking you to join me by signing your name in support of my common sense gun violence prevention bill. body:

This is former Green Beret and current US Congressman Mike Waltz. _**I’m writing you today to share why I’m parachuting into Normandy for the 80th anniversary of D-Day tomorrow.**_ **I should tell you, it won’t be my first time.** I made this same jump in 2019 to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the invasion of Normandy. I did it back then for the same reason; to honor the sacrifice of the soldiers who fought to defend our country and free Europe from NAZI oppression. Truly, it’s an honor to pay tribute to those American heroes who jumped into enemy territory. A few of my fellow veteran Congressmen will join me in this jump. Among our ranks, we have all kinds of veterans from Paratroopers to Navy SEALs! **As veterans, we have an immense respect for the brave men who embarked upon the Great Crusade so many years ago.** Every day, we try to honor their legacy in the halls of Congress. Here are just a couple of ways we do that:
* We always stand up for what is right.
* We always defend our nation and its citizens.
* We always fight off antisemitic forces.
* We **NEVER** put anything above American interests.

Now more than ever, we need to honor & preserve the legacy of the Greatest Generation. I wish I could tell you that forces like the NAZIs didn’t still exist. And I wish I could tell you that there weren’t elected US officials supporting them. But the fact is, _America has been infiltrated by antisemitic, pro-Hamas radicals!_ **I'm fighting against these extremists and I'm asking for your help today. Close your eyes for just a second and imagine... 💭 Imagine a world where the air is unpolluted, the water is clean, and our children and future generations grow up in a thriving, sustainable environment. A world where climate disasters at every turn are a distant memory. Sounds like a dream, right? Well, it doesn’t have to be. We can make this our reality, but we need to unite now and fight back against the greedy fossil fuel industry that’s been putting profits over our planet for far too long. Today marks exactly five months until Election Day. This November is our best — and possibly last — chance to break the fossil fuel industry's chokehold on our government and save the environment from irreversible climate damage. The fossil fuel industry is already spending millions to prop up candidates and ballot measures that will strengthen their grip on our political system. But we’re not about to let them win, are we? = | = At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, our mission is clear: defeat politicians who are in bed with the fossil fuel industry and replace them with climate champions at all levels of government. We’re targeting races where we can make the most significant impact — especially those down-ballot contests that often go unnoticed but are crucial for shaping environmental policy. Here’s what we’ve been up to: 🌍 Field Program: We are building a robust volunteer-led voter contact field program that will drive turnout in races that will have an outsized impact on climate policy. We are going to recruit volunteers, identify pro-climate voters, call voters, write postcards, and get out the vote for our climate champions! 🌍 Targeted Endorsements: We’ve carefully selected over a dozen climate candidates who are committed to bold climate action. From our upcoming endorsements for climate champions across Arizona to Rep. Greg Casar in TX-35, Laura Friedman in CA-30, and pro-environment city council candidates in Portland, Oregon: these leaders are fighting against LNG projects, pushing for a just transition away from fossil fuels, advocating for clean energy, and more. Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to hear about this exciting event taking place June 17th, brought to you in part by Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=93b9b50903-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Attn Grassroots:
Roger Stone is Coming to IL!
https://www.theconservativecaucus.org/event-details/roger-stone?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=93b9b50903-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Joe Biden and his Democratic political operatives have convicted President Donald Trump on fake crimes and now they want him to go to jail! But they are not after Trump – they’re after us – and we’re next. This election in November is the most important in the history of our country because so much is at stake, including our very existence as conservative grassroot Republicans.

On June 17, in the northwest suburbs of Chicago, GOP strategist and political icon Roger Stone will be in town to headline a fundraiser in support of The Conservative Caucus. Founded in 1974 in Washington, DC, The Conservative Caucus is the oldest conservative grassroots organization in the country.

The event features a private VIP reception and meet and greet with Roger Stone, followed by the main event. For sponsors, enjoy a private, off-the-record dinner discussion with Roger.
For tickets or to be a sponsor, please visit:
https://www.theconservativecaucus.org/event-details/roger-stone?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=93b9b50903-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

About Roger Stone:

Roger Stone is a legendary Republican strategist, political icon and pundit, who has served as a senior campaign aide to 3 Republican presidents including Richard Nixon and Ronald Reagan. He is a New York Times bestselling author and a longtime friend and advisor to President Donald Trump since 1978.

As an outspoken Libertarian, Stone has appeared on thousands of broadcasts, spoken at countless venues and lectured before the prestigious Oxford Political Union and the Cambridge Union Society. Due to his over 40 years in the political and cultural arena, Stone has become a pop culture icon.

In 2016, Netflix launched a documentary called Get Me Roger Stone that featured interviews with Donald Trump, and it’s been viewed by tens of millions of people from around the world.

And with the unprecedented authoritarian action taken by Joe Biden and the Democrats to convict President Trump on phony charges, this election is the most important in American history.

Unfortunately, and I hate to say this, we're losing. As things stand, Arizona will elect a Senator who openly celebrated yesterday's egregious ruling.

Before I ask you for anything, I want you to know that my parents taught me to do a good job, do the right thing, keep my head down, worship God, and not ask anyone for anything.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6633%2E5257348%2Egkzw5N ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

In the days since a jury of 12 ordinary Americans ruled that Donald Trump
is guilty on all 34 felony counts of business fraud, the former president
has been on a tear — attacking the judge, jury, justice system, and
anything else that causes him aggrievement.

I’m running for the U.S. Senate where I will continue to hold Trump to

## **Michael Cloud Wants To Defund Law Enforcement**
---
Hi Peter, My opponent, Michael Cloud, just introduced legislation to defund Fani Willis and Alvin Bragg because Trump broke the law in their jurisdictions and they are trying to uphold the law in America.
The federal appropriations for local DAs and law enforcement are used for prosecuting bad guys and evil doers in our local jurisdictions. Cutting off funding for local law enforcement (defunding the police) makes us all less safe, whether you or your kids go to NYC or Atlanta for business, an FFA Convention, or attend a band trip -- it makes it more likely that you or your loved ones will be hurt, and that the person that hurt them will avoid punishment. Cloud's ideas might ingratiate him with convicted felon Donald Trump, but it will hurt the rest of us.
---

---

If the law is unjust, the conviction will be vacated. | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=81c6a639917f43c081063fedb77a3e3f&_e=V7b9VreYipfrFyQnTZIweGhHrDagIfu7H8S7inNSnOtMhIfu2ka43q19tndAJVil0fGsx3ikmomDUJJsAdKj3iW4sVgIixQyJYeYL6-JC9UflW43jf4NEz8vFUSdLX2ihxtqJzZ_JCxJQoRnB8Arf6MPycFCu3Du4Q5Y1qU4Bq0Ky0yjrLAEudYCtdxQ6SkFFneTyxJl8B690YcedwD7O22aKUymCKuLSP25eYXZtPJHpYoEaWNyb5HOMoWoKlkuXCBUAQ-1KGPO1ukGG6uisQmQ1oMR9Al9_5o_gHj2tUQdA4GMXwpmdUGU-FXCRzjVz2WtKxMowhO6aUkgOj7yay6mI7jv3mdOWLTvcSF48f2pwrIagUoSrBC_E8OkWwJ_86017j9F0mbe0822iAEtaA%3D%3D)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=81c6a639917f43c081063fedb77a3e3f&_e=V7b9VreYipfrFyQnTZIweGhHrDagIfu7H8S7inNSnOtMhIfu2ka43q19tndAJVil0fGsx3ikmomDUJJsAdKj3iW4sVgIixQyJYeYL6-JC9UflW43jf4NEz8vFUSdLX2ihxtqJzZ_JCxJQoRnB8Arf6MPycFCu3Du4Q5Y1qU4Bq0Ky0yjrLAEudYCtdxQ6SkFFneTyxJl8B690YcedwD7O22aKUymCKuLSP25eYXZtPJHpYoEaWNyb5HOMoWoKlkuy2LV0Uw0zgh-l-lh3kSlzp10_-CcZdp7tfD8Ex1u6QjdQRqdsVYy8smsT_C0y1uFwQKmaOyl1HIZGdw2MiVNTEHwRh8yyR5_44M7IeDDhkvz2VIWzOLG_VHiD5hhHnZ0L8HBOpwhOzv9UKlnC_wQ_A%3D%3D) [No](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=81c6a639917f43c081063fedb77a3e3f&_e=V7b9VreYipfrFyQnTZIweGhHrDagIfu7H8S7inNSnOtMhIfu2ka43q19tndAJVil0fGsx3ikmomDUJJsAdKj3iW4sVgIixQyJYeYL6-JC9UflW43jf4NEz8vFUSdLX2ihxtqJzZ_JCxJQoRnB8Arf6MPycFCu3Du4Q5Y1qU4Bq0Ky0yjrLAEudYCtdxQ6SkFFneTyxJl8B690YcedwD7O22aKUymCKuLSP25eYXZtPJHpYoEaWNyb5HOMoWoKlkutkpOwR52ku9VvbjlbJQ2oTWEz9KwsEHeDcvVoVrqaghLHBqPKSVJHEcGMqHwm2Nx-Wa3boZrKTtmLZBSClcgWRDgo7k1k9rLcy2kIJF68nlux4iZ0K13i4Nl-2K9tLgnScFmcFYmhwViJ6GAdZUuuQ%3D%3D) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=81c6a639917f43c081063fedb77a3e3f&_e=V7b9VreYipfrFyQnTZIweGhHrDagIfu7H8S7inNSnOtMhIfu2ka43q19tndAJVil0fGsx3ikmomDUJJsAdKj3iW4sVgIixQyJYeYL6-JC9UflW43jf4NEz8vFUSdLX2ihxtqJzZ_JCxJQoRnB8Arf6MPycFCu3Du4Q5Y1qU4Bq0Ky0yjrLAEudYCtdxQ6SkFFneTyxJl8B690YcedwD7O22aKUymCKuLSP25eYXZtPJHpYoEaWNyb5HOMoWoKlkutPmxDSw0iLmGBZi16gK5I7AqD61cCs1Cn4jhn9KGubDxAAplhb1m2jTxcL9-qXYy8y4gsxvecU7mSr6LyimOTJwY8IOXsctjE5EunKSuQAoDZPPB3aAX0kjgSLcjwZ6VOeSL-Mm2iyEyi4_eZFkiTA%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That's because we're seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=81c6a639917f43c081063fedb77a3e3f&_e=V7b9VreYipfrFyQnTZIweGhHrDagIfu7H8S7inNSnOtMhIfu2ka43q19tndAJVil0fGsx3ikmomDUJJsAdKj3iW4sVgIixQyJYeYL6-JC9UflW43jf4NEz8vFUSdLX2ihxtqJzZ_JCxJQoRnB8Arf6MPycFCu3Du4Q5Y1qU4Bq0Ky0yjrLAEudYCtdxQ6SkFFneTyxJl8B690YcedwD7O22aKUymCKuLSP25eYXZtPJHpYoEaWNyb5HOMoWoKlkuebCe2Y8JpkbYZvuTV9tVxVr_Ngr0bQMVVRyoB91p3lppWGISAQFAu394-rPj-uaOxkrP9IV1SsmeOg11fn1AEc5HFreRYb3FuG-qCSJ2ia_eDAwoeA6qg0myLCN3XYFvW8tBbJPI_Lyp8UWqK_3Y-g%3D%3D) For our children, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

Dear Peter,
If we don’t change the path we're on, the American people will go from citizen to subject – _subject to our government and their complicit corporate accomplices_.
I am the only candidate for President who will make sure that doesn’t happen. When I am President, you, the people, will be in charge.
I may be independent but I am not independent of you. Join our team and let’s get our country back on track!
---

---
As President, Here are five things I will do to get the country back on the right track:
1. Dismantle the broken two-party system: Put you, the people, back in charge.
2. Secure the border and save American jobs: Fill the gaps in the wall and reinstate the migrant protection act requiring those with asylum claims to remain in Mexico.
3. Significantly drop the level of chronic disease in our children: I have been committed to this my entire career and if I can’t accomplish this in my first term, do not re-elect me.
4. Stop the Federal Government from lying to you: Any federal employee caught lying will be dismissed.
5. Revive the American Dream: It used to be if you worked hard and played by the rules, you could buy a home and raise a family ... and all on one job. I will take on the corporations stifling the American Dream and return it to you.

I am not afraid to meet this challenge. I will change the path we’re and put you back in charge! But I can’t do it without you on the team.
Let’s change the path together! | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=509707c7c65547c183dc459bdaba07e1&_t=j24zOhGR0-BgxzsPPQBiqnVn9PBMgiUwHUZtnMBY3DuIDDDHqZiYRQDtf_lJDEv0hdNsUHMAqwcELSktMD9td1zIwfRHZ5_E3yShsY9RzaZa1Sq5St0AyHnrlXtiO5zn)_

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=509707c7c65547c183dc459bdaba07e1&_e=uZAhdmxm0l5TK8wLu-sw5eb0yL2eoDbfiA0Q9X7VsItYjJXy_jr43Athb_FUeeqLf-90ecZLtT2hc4jBdWjBCLIfN8hT106NpKJthm1MlAQCI9hev_sAmQEWBd7YvsPA_-lB95Xz762ht-qUw3iEfKTEquajQkwj_J6KWpL_1n5o33GK6iP6l0bs7yTaZWibgs4BWbbVGZFNgEg1j1ds2qOrWSmqwM_b_8otPEYQT5lGKOez-jBTNZN5Kg33783YR-DZMXo4rPgmdorkeT8f7bzstyFa9Rrm30p_a6o4lSiwaoXE1Q0CY8Eo1MD1SYKWkXuJnF-4Lt7JLqjXOdDFI8_E6g5EmE9eIac8HFH08YwhS1vmRMC8xJPpo8Mnu12ztJ59IRPavsnoJeMkRJwuwOiuAzx23Xc2hWhvVwwf2sg%3D)

Dear Friend,

You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty.

Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=509707c7c65547c183dc459bdaba07e1&_e=uZAhdmxm0l5TK8wLu-sw5eb0yL2eoDbfiA0Q9X7VsItYjJXy_jr43Athb_FUeeqLf-90ecZLtT2hc4jBdWjBCLIfN8hT106NpKJthm1MlAQCI9hev_sAmQEWBd7YvsPA_-lB95Xz762ht-qUw3iEfKTEquajQkwj_J6KWpL_1n5o33GK6iP6l0bs7yTaZWibgs4BWbbVGZFNgEg1j1ds2qOrWSmqwM_b_8otPEYQT5lGKOez-jBTNZN5Kg33783YR-DZMXo4rPgmdorkeT8f7YOwoPRJ1SC47chNmX5nQWZx5W3SVswPz1xPFDJciKGYhcW1HIPNT0VgtrHSRF8lHOrScA64yqEQWr9MYLI2xlpGeRWaSeLHOxpUYlD1QF25VlmgCnjcHZdAi85HUFigQX9ZbIZu4BEtvplTVU0H1Qg%3D)

Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."**

Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion."

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.**

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=509707c7c65547c183dc459bdaba07e1&_e=uZAhdmxm0l5TK8wLu-sw5eb0yL2eoDbfiA0Q9X7VsItYjJXy_jr43Athb_FUeeqLf-90ecZLtT2hc4jBdWjBCLIfN8hT106NpKJthm1MlAQCI9hev_sAmQEWBd7YvsPA_-lB95Xz762ht-qUw3iEfKTEquajQkwj_J6KWpL_1n5o33GK6iP6l0bs7yTaZWibgs4BWbbVGZFNgEg1j1ds2qOrWSmqwM_b_8otPEYQT5lGKOez-jBTNZN5Kg33783YR-DZMXo4rPgmdorkeT8f7YvDJgwcqsp6M6rbL6IxWSy3TJKU9UdqhiEYI2EektyBoiaIEsqPFmlu8qzGaxnGTUiSpeHFfYAaK41bCdvQJrNy8LH54mJtoe0lVbNfK53V6wZfDehvH586I37sfIpCdhFo5SOfxuvJmtr80TnK0Qc%3D)

Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Folks, the general election is here.
It’s official:**We’re facing off against Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate Tim Sheehy in 2024’s most important Senate race.**
This is the most critical moment of our campaign so far. How we respond now will determine whether we’re able to defend this seat or allow some wealthy outsider to buy it out from under us.
[**I need your help now more than ever. Split $5 or more right now between my campaign and Elissa Slotkin to become an exclusive General Election Founding Donor.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-tester-june24.1OeLyX&refcode=em240605-2-15&t=2&akid=1505%2E135344%2Et6Aro7)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why are grocery prices so high?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Giant corporations want you to think that it’s just because of inflation. It’s not.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2196%2E4032634%2EEPOwTR)
---
Let me state the obvious here for a second: Grocery store prices are too damn high. Giant corporations want you to think that it’s just because of inflation. But that’s ignoring two other big factors at play here: consolidation and greed. You see, when grocery stores have less competition, they have less incentive to attract consumers with lower prices or higher quality. And right now, just four big companies — Walmart, Costco, Kroger, and Ahold — control over 70% of the grocery market in most major cities. And this isn’t just about companies that own the grocery stores. It’s about the companies that fill the shelves. A couple of big cereal manufacturers control nearly 60% of the market. A single company controls about 20% of the egg market. Four corporations control 85% of the beef industry and 75% of the pork industry. How did we get here? Literally hundreds of mergers over the last 50 years. So with limited competition, grocery store and food giants are enabled to price gouge consumers and blame inflation. Families are now paying 25% more for groceries as compared to before the pandemic. Big food companies want to keep these huge profits and they're hiring plenty of lobbyists to keep Congress from acting. So I’m encouraging President Biden to exercise his executive authority to take additional action to address rising food prices without Congress. **[More on my plan below, but we need to show that Americans are paying attention to this issue and are calling for action. Please add your name if high grocery store prices are affecting you, and you agree that the greedy food and grocery store corporations need regulatory intervention.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1?refcode=EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1&t=8&akid=2196%2E4032634%2EEPOwTR)** | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1?refcode=EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1&t=9&akid=2196%2E4032634%2EEPOwTR)
---
President Biden has been bringing his administration to bear on this issue — taking robust action to push down costs for families.
Massachusetts Congressman Jim McGovern and I have written a letter to President Biden urging his administration to continue using all the tools on his desk like to address rising food prices and lower food prices for families. This includes:
* Encouraging the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to work with the U.S. Department of Agriculture to prohibit exclusionary contracting by dominant firms in the food industry.
* Urging the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the FTC to scrutinize, and where appropriate, block mergers and acquisitions in the food and agricultural sectors.
* Tapping in the DOJ to prosecute actors in the agricultural and food sectors for price fixing and other anticompetitive behavior.
* Directing the CFTC and FTC to form a joint task force to investigate food price manipulation throughout the supply chain.

And that’s just to name a few of the tools we have to tackle this. These actions from the administration would complement my Price Gouging Prevention Act and Shrinkflation Prevention Act with Senator Bob Casey, which would crack down on corporate price gouging across the board.
Look, families are identifying the cost of food and groceries as the top issue they've been facing. The federal government should use every possible tool to lower food prices — whether that’s by passing legislation or using the authority of federal departments.
**[I’m pulling on every lever possible to get relief to working families. Please add your name to say you support this work and you agree that the government should step in and hold giant food and grocery store companies accountable.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1?refcode=EMZ20P_FIN_E_20240601_V1S1&t=10&akid=2196%2E4032634%2EEPOwTR)**
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
